Mctt.Core.Completeness.Inductives.Iota

The ι Rule of a Group

The eliminator at a constructor of the member m is the constructor's branch at the non-uniform parameters, the arguments and the recursive results (elim_ihs): one per leaf path of each recursive argument (leaf_ih), the eliminator at the argument applied to the domains the path passes and projected at the fields it passes, under the domains. Under a domain its value is not the eliminator's own recursive result (d_ihfn), so the rule relates the two along the path (rec_result_rel): at the end of the path, the eliminator at its blocks moved past the domains, in the environment extended by the domains' values, against the eliminator at its own (an outer link of Elim.v). The paths walk the frames of Elim.v: a recursive argument of the constructor, then the recursive fields of the record views the path passes.

#[local] Open Scope list_scope.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

Lemma eval_exps_firstn' : forall Ms ρ ms k, ⟦ Ms ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ ms ->
    ⟦ List.firstn k Ms ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ List.firstn k ms.
Proof.
  induction Ms as [| M Ms IH]; intros * H; inversion H; subst; destruct k; cbn; try constructor; [ assumption | apply IH; assumption ].
Qed.

The non-recursive arguments of a list of arguments followed by more: the later ones' first.
Lemma cargs_nonrec_ctx_app : forall gs1 gs2, cargs_nonrec_ctx (gs1 ++ gs2) = cargs_nonrec_ctx gs2 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1.
Proof.
  induction gs1 as [| [r A | t] gs1 IH]; intros gs2; cbn [List.app cargs_nonrec_ctx];
    [ rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity | rewrite IH, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | exact (IH gs2) ].
Qed.

The values, of a referenced constructor's kinds, of its non-uniform parameters and its arguments: the parameters' values (relevant, con_kinds_skipn), then the arguments' of their kinds.
Lemma con_ref_vals_split : forall D k Mk gs Ns As ρ vs, decl_typed gc_deps gc_stack D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
    List.length Ns = im_nn Mk ->
    eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (List.skipn (ind_nu D) (con_kinds D Mk gs)) (Ns ++ As) ρ vs ->
    exists ns avs, vs = ns ++ avs /\ ⟦ Ns ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ ns /\
      eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_kinds gs) As ρ avs.
Proof.
  intros * Hdt HM HNl H.
  rewrite (con_kinds_skipn D k Mk gs Hdt HM) in H by (unfold im_np; lia).
  replace (im_np D Mk - ind_nu D) with (List.length Ns) in H by (unfold im_np; lia).
  destruct (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_app_inv _ _ _ _ _ H) as (ns & avs & -> & Hns & Has).
  exists ns, avs; split; [ reflexivity | split ].
  - apply (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_exps_of_field_vals _ _ _ _ Hns); intros j Hj.
    rewrite List.app_nth1 by (rewrite List.repeat_length; exact Hj); rewrite List.nth_repeat; constructor.
  - rewrite List.skipn_app, List.skipn_all2, List.repeat_length, Nat.sub_diag in Has by (rewrite List.repeat_length; lia).
    exact Has.
Qed.

And conversely.
Lemma con_ref_vals_join : forall D k Mk gs Ns As ρ ns avs, decl_typed gc_deps gc_stack D -> ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
    List.length Ns = im_nn Mk ->
    ⟦ Ns ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ ns -> eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_kinds gs) As ρ avs ->
    eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (List.skipn (ind_nu D) (con_kinds D Mk gs)) (Ns ++ As) ρ (ns ++ avs).
Proof.
  intros * Hdt HM HNl Hns Has.
  rewrite (con_kinds_skipn D k Mk gs Hdt HM) by (unfold im_np; lia).
  replace (im_np D Mk - ind_nu D) with (List.length Ns) by (unfold im_np; lia).
  apply Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_app.
  - apply Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_of_exps; [| exact Hns ]; intros j Hj.
    rewrite List.app_nth1 by (rewrite List.repeat_length; exact Hj); rewrite List.nth_repeat; constructor.
  - rewrite List.skipn_app, List.skipn_all2, List.repeat_length, Nat.sub_diag by (rewrite List.repeat_length; lia).
    exact Has.
Qed.

The terms of the non-recursive arguments among As, of the kinds gs.
Fixpoint nonrec_arg_terms (gs : list carg) (As : list exp) : list exp :=
  match gs, As with
  | ca_arg _ _ :: gs, A :: As => A :: nonrec_arg_terms gs As
  | ca_rec _ :: gs, _ :: As => nonrec_arg_terms gs As
  | _, _ => nil
  end.

The substitution extended by the non-recursive arguments is the substitution extended by their list.
Lemma cargs_sub_of_list : forall gs σ As, cargs_sub σ gs As = sb_of_list σ (nonrec_arg_terms gs As).
Proof. induction gs as [| [r A | t] gs IH]; intros σ [| N As]; cbn; try reflexivity; apply IH. Qed.

Lemma length_nonrec_arg_terms : forall gs As, List.length As = List.length gs ->
    List.length (nonrec_arg_terms gs As) = List.length (cargs_nonrec gs).
Proof. induction gs as [| [r A | t] gs IH]; intros [| N As] Hl; cbn in *; try discriminate; try reflexivity; rewrite IH; lia. Qed.

The values of the arguments of their sorts give those of the non-recursive ones, of theirs.
Lemma eval_field_vals_nonrec : forall gs rest As ρ avs,
    eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_kinds gs ++ rest) As ρ avs -> List.length As = List.length gs ->
    eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_nonrec_kinds gs) (nonrec_arg_terms gs As) ρ (nonrec_arg_vals gs avs).
Proof.
  induction gs as [| [r A | t] gs IH]; intros rest [| N As] ρ avs H Hl; cbn in Hl; try discriminate.
  - inversion H; subst; cbn; constructor.
  - cbn [cargs_kinds List.map List.app] in H; inversion H; subst; cbn [nonrec_arg_terms nonrec_arg_vals cargs_nonrec_kinds].
    + eapply eval_field_vals_evaluated; [ assumption | eassumption | apply (IH rest); [ eassumption | lia ] ].
    + eapply eval_field_vals_proof; [ assumption | apply (IH rest); [ eassumption | lia ] ].
  - cbn [cargs_kinds List.map List.app] in H; inversion H; subst; cbn [nonrec_arg_terms nonrec_arg_vals cargs_nonrec_kinds];
      [ apply (IH rest); [ eassumption | lia ] | discriminate ].
Qed.

The sorts of the non-recursive arguments of gs1 ++ gs2: those of gs1, then those of gs2.
Lemma cargs_nonrec_kinds_app : forall gs1 gs2,
    cargs_nonrec_kinds (gs1 ++ gs2) = cargs_nonrec_kinds gs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_kinds gs2.
Proof. induction gs1 as [| [r A | t] gs1 IH]; intros; cbn; rewrite ?IH; reflexivity. Qed.

The substitution extended by the non-recursive arguments of gs is scoped where the arguments and the substitution are.
Lemma cargs_sub_bound : forall gs σ As n m, (forall x, x < n -> sentry_scoped m (σ x)) ->
    List.Forall (exp_scoped m) As -> List.length As = List.length gs ->
    forall x, x < List.length (cargs_nonrec gs) + n -> sentry_scoped m (cargs_sub σ gs As x).
Proof.
  induction gs as [| [r A | t] gs IH]; intros σ [| N As] n m Hσ HAs Hl x Hx; cbn in Hl, Hx |- *; try discriminate.
  - exact (Hσ x Hx).
  - inversion_clear HAs; apply (IH _ _ (S n)); [ apply sb_ext_bound; assumption | assumption | lia | lia ].
  - inversion_clear HAs; apply (IH _ _ n); [ assumption | assumption | lia | lia ].
Qed.

An entry of a telescope moved by a substitution: the entry of the telescope at the same position, moved past the entries after it.
Lemma tele_sub_split_at : forall X σ Δ1 κ T Δ2, all_assumptions X -> tele_sub X σ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
    exists X1 A X2, X = X1 ++ ce_ass κ A :: X2 /\ List.length X1 = List.length Δ1 /\ T = A[sb_qn (List.length X2) σ] /\
      Δ2 = tele_sub X2 σ.
Proof.
  induction X as [| e X IH]; intros σ Δ1 κ T Δ2 Ha H; cbn [tele_sub] in H; [ destruct Δ1; discriminate |].
  assert (He : exists κ0 A, e = ce_ass κ0 A) by (inversion Ha as [| ? ? He _]; exact He).
  destruct He as (κ0 & A & ->).
  assert (Ha' : all_assumptions X) by (inversion Ha; assumption).
  destruct Δ1 as [| d Δ1]; cbn [List.app] in H.
  - injection H as -> H1 H2.
    exists nil, A, X; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ reflexivity | split; [ exact (eq_sym H1) | exact (eq_sym H2) ] ] ].
  - injection H as H1 H2.
    destruct (IH σ Δ1 κ T Δ2 Ha' H2) as (X1 & A' & X2 & -> & L1 & -> & ->).
    exists (ce_ass κ0 A :: X1), A', X2; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ cbn; lia | split; reflexivity ] ].
Qed.

An entry of the recursive results along the leaf paths ls: the result along one of them, after those before it.
Lemma leaves_ctx_split_at : forall r nn As Us na pat ls j Δ1 κ T Δ2,
    leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat j ls = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
    exists n l, List.nth_error ls n = Some l /\
      T = leaf_ihty r As (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn ((j + n) + na + nn))) (ihs_sub nn Us na pat (j + n))
            (a_var ((j + n) + na - 1 - List.length pat)) l /\
      Δ2 = leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat j (List.firstn n ls).
Proof.
  intros r nn As Us na pat; induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros j Δ1 κ T Δ2 H; cbn [leaves_ctx] in H; [ destruct Δ1; discriminate |].
  set (L := leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat (S j) ls) in *.
  destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases (List.length Δ1) (List.length L)) as [Hlt | Hge].
  - destruct (app_split_prefix Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) L _ (eq_sym H) ltac:(lia)) as (m1 & EL & Em).
    destruct m1 as [| d m1]; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r in EL; subst L; rewrite <- EL in Hlt; lia |].
    cbn [List.app] in Em; injection Em as <- ->.
    destruct (IH (S j) Δ1 κ T m1 EL) as (n & l' & Hn & -> & ->).
    exists (S n), l'; split; [ exact Hn | split ].
    + replace (j + S n) with (S j + n) by lia; reflexivity.
    + cbn [List.firstn leaves_ctx]; reflexivity.
  - destruct (app_split_prefix L _ Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) H Hge) as (m1 & EΔ & Em).
    destruct m1 as [| d m1]; cbn [List.app] in Em.
    + injection Em as _ HT HΔ; subst Δ2.
      exists 0, l; split; [ reflexivity | split; [ rewrite Nat.add_0_r; exact (eq_sym HT) | reflexivity ] ].
    + injection Em as _ Em; destruct m1; discriminate.
Qed.

Retagging at a context twice is retagging once: the tags of the later entries are those of the retagged ones already.
Lemma ctx_retag_idempotent : forall Δ ρ, ctx_retag Δ (ctx_retag Δ ρ) = ctx_retag Δ ρ.
Proof.
  induction Δ as [| e Δ IH]; intros ρ; [ reflexivity |].
  cbn [ctx_retag List.tl List.hd]; rewrite IH, retag_entry_twice; reflexivity.
Qed.

per_head_inst for a type at a level: the head relation of the instance at related environments is the type's at their values.
Lemma per_head_inst_type : forall Δ0 Γ0 A (i : nat) τ RΓ0 E E' Eτ Eτ',
    Δ0 ⊨ᵗ A ≈ A at i -> EF Γ0 ≈ Γ0 ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ0 -> Γ0 ⊨ˢ τ ≈ τ : Δ0 ->
    RΓ0 E E' -> ⟦ τ : Δ0 ⟧s E ↘ Eτ -> ⟦ τ : Δ0 ⟧s E' ↘ Eτ' ->
    (per_head A[τ] A[τ] E E' <~> per_head A A Eτ Eτ').
Proof.
  intros * HA HΓ0 Hτ HE Hev Hev'.
  destruct (rel_type_inversion HA) as (R & HR & Hgen).
  destruct (Hgen _ _ HΓ0 _ _ Hτ _ _ _ _ HE Hev Hev') as [a b c d Ha Hb Hc Hd Hch].
  assert (Had : Dom a ≈ d ∈ per_univ i) by pairwise.
  destruct Had as [R1 HR1].
  assert (Ch : rel_chain (per_univ_elem i R1) (a :: b :: c :: d :: nil))
    by (eapply per_univ_chain_at_in; [ exact Hch | | | exact HR1 ]; solve_in).
  assert (Hbc : DF b ≈ c ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R1) by pairwise.
  etransitivity; [ symmetry; eapply per_head_iff; [ exact Ha | exact Hd | exact HR1 ] |].
  eapply per_head_iff; [ exact Hb | exact Hc | exact Hbc ].
Qed.

A recursive argument is of the relevant sort.
Lemma cargs_kinds_rec : forall gs1 t gs2,
    List.nth (List.length gs1) (cargs_kinds (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2)) ak_relevant = ak_relevant.
Proof.
  intros; unfold cargs_kinds; rewrite List.map_app, List.app_nth2, List.length_map, Nat.sub_diag
    by (rewrite List.length_map; lia); reflexivity.
Qed.

The components' substitution of a shape after the arguments gs, past their non-recursive ones: the substitution they extend.
Lemma cargs_sub_ge : forall gs σ As y, List.length gs <= List.length As ->
    cargs_sub σ gs As (y + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs)) = σ y.
Proof.
  induction gs as [| [B | t] gs IH]; intros σ [| N As] y Hl; cbn in Hl |- *; try lia.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r; reflexivity.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r; reflexivity.
  - replace (y + S (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs))) with (S y + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs)) by lia.
    rewrite IH by lia; reflexivity.
  - apply IH; lia.
Qed.

The recursive results of arguments gs1 ++ gs2: those of gs1, then those of gs2.
Lemma cargs_nrec_app_iota : forall Dx gs1 gs2, cargs_nrec Dx (gs1 ++ gs2) = cargs_nrec Dx gs1 + cargs_nrec Dx gs2.
Proof. intros Dx; induction gs1 as [| [] gs1 IH]; intros; cbn; rewrite ?IH; lia. Qed.

The recursive results of a recursive argument along its leaf paths ls1 ++ ls2, as a context: those of ls2 over those of ls1.
Lemma leaves_ctx_app : forall r nn As Us na pat ls1 ls2 j,
    leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat j (ls1 ++ ls2) = leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat (j + List.length ls1) ls2 ++ leaves_ctx r nn As Us na pat j ls1.
Proof.
  intros r nn As Us na pat ls1; induction ls1 as [| l1 ls1 IH]; intros ls2 j; cbn [leaves_ctx List.app List.length];
    [ rewrite Nat.add_0_r, List.app_nil_r; reflexivity |].
  rewrite IH, <- List.app_assoc; replace (S j + List.length ls1) with (j + S (List.length ls1)) by lia; reflexivity.
Qed.

The names of the non-recursive fields of fs1 ++ fs2.
Lemma fields_args_app : forall fs1 fs2, fields_args (fs1 ++ fs2) = fields_args fs1 ++ fields_args fs2.
Proof. induction fs1 as [| [? []] fs1 IH]; intros; cbn; rewrite ?IH; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma length_fields_args : forall fs, List.length (fields_args fs) = List.length (cargs_nonrec (List.map snd fs)).
Proof. induction fs as [| [? []] fs IH]; cbn; lia. Qed.

The functions of a list of bodies under a domain A, of value a.
Lemma eval_exps_fns : forall (ls : list leaf_path) A a F ρ, ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a ->
    ⟦ List.map (fun l => λ A (F l)) ls ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ List.map (fun l => λᵈ a ρ (F l)) ls.
Proof. induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros * Ea; cbn [List.map]; constructor; [ constructor; exact Ea | apply IH; exact Ea ]. Qed.

The functions of the recursive results along paths through a domain A, applied to a value c: their bodies at the environment extended by c.
Lemma eval_exps_fns_app : forall (ls : list leaf_path) A a F ρ rs c rcs, ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a ->
    ⟦ List.map (fun l => λ A (F l)) ls ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ rs ->
    ⟦ List.map F ls ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↦ c ⦂ entry_type_value a ↘ rcs ->
    List.Forall2 (fun f r => $| f & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r) rs rcs.
Proof.
  induction ls as [| l ls IH]; intros * Ea E1 E2; cbn [List.map] in E1, E2; inversion E1; subst; inversion E2; subst; constructor.
  - match goal with H : ⟦ λ _ _ ⟧ _ ↘ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst end.
    match goal with H : ⟦ A ⟧ _ ↘ ?a' |- _ => assert (a' = a) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption) end.
    constructor; assumption.
  - eapply IH; [ exact Ea | eassumption | eassumption ].
Qed.

The functions of the eliminator's own recursive results under a domain, applied to a value c: the recursive results of the rest at the argument applied to c.
Lemma ihfn_app : forall ρ Bks p0 ups t v c fc rcs n,
    $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc -> ⟦ih fc of t under p0 ups Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ rcs ->
    List.length rcs = n ->
    List.Forall2 (fun f r => $| f & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r) (List.map (fun i => d_ihfn ρ Bks p0 ups t i v) (List.seq 0 n)) rcs.
Proof.
  intros * Ef Eih Ln.
  assert (G : forall k l, List.skipn k rcs = l ->
             List.Forall2 (fun f r => $| f & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r)
               (List.map (fun i => d_ihfn ρ Bks p0 ups t i v) (List.seq k (List.length l))) l).
  { intros k l; revert k; induction l as [| r l IH]; intros k Hs; cbn [List.length List.seq List.map]; constructor.
    - assert (Hk : k < List.length rcs)
        by (pose proof (f_equal (@List.length domain) Hs) as HL; rewrite List.length_skipn in HL; cbn in HL; lia).
      eapply eval_app_ihfn; [ exact Ef | exact Eih |].
      rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn k rcs), Hs, List.nth_error_app2 by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      rewrite List.length_firstn; replace (k - Nat.min k (List.length rcs)) with 0 by lia; reflexivity.
    - apply IH.
      replace (S k) with (1 + k) by lia; rewrite <- List.skipn_skipn, Hs; reflexivity. }
  pose proof (G 0 rcs eq_refl) as H; rewrite Ln in H; exact H.
Qed.

The Eliminator at Blocks Moved by a Substitution

The blocks Bks of an eliminator of the group D at p, of a valid family VP, valid in Γ at the uniform parameters Us: moved by a substitution β into Ψ, the eliminator at a member j with a block is valid there.
Section Blocks.
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Ua : all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) := uparams_ass D Hc.

  Variable (Γ : ctx) (Us : list exp) (Bks : list eblock) (i : nat).
  Hypotheses (HΓ : ⊨ Γ) (HUl : List.length Us = ind_nu D)
    (HUs : forall k U T, List.nth_error Us k = Some U -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) k = Some T -> Γ ⊨ U : T)
    (HUss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Us)
    (HBks : List.length Bks = ind_nblk D)
    (HnmA : blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks)
    (HMall : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ)
    (HAv : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
             elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b : Typeω@i)
    (HnaA : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mj) (eb_brs b))
    (HBc : forall j Mj c gs, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             ⊨ elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ)
    (HarA : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
              In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mj + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat)
    (HBv : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
             elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ ⊨ B : elim_branch_type p D j Mj c gs (eb_motive b) Us).

The uniform parameters moved by a weakening past k entries are scoped there.
  Lemma uparams_wk_scoped : forall β k, sb_eq β (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn k)) ->
      List.Forall (exp_scoped (k + List.length Γ)) (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us).
  Proof.
    intros β k Hβ; apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HUss ].
    intros U HU; apply (exp_scoped_sub _ _ _ _ HU); intros x Hx; rewrite (Hβ x); cbn; lia.
  Qed.

The eliminator at blocks moved by a substitution into Ψ, at a member with a block.
  Lemma elim_moved_valid : forall Ψ β j Mj Ns M, gsub Ψ β Γ -> ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Ψ)) (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) ->
      List.length Ns = im_nn Mj ->
      (forall k N T, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us)) Ns) k = Some T -> Ψ ⊨ N : T) ->
      List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Ψ)) Ns ->
      Ψ ⊨ M : ind_mty p D j (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) Ns -> exp_scoped (List.length Ψ) M ->
      Ψ ⊨ a_elim ak_relevant p (List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) j (blocks_sub Bks β) M
        : (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_prop)[sb_of_list β (Ns ++ M :: nil)].
  Proof.
    intros * Hβ HMj Hrv HUs0s HNl HNs HNss HM HMs.
    set (Us0 := List.map (fun U => U[β]) Us) in *.
    set (Bks0 := blocks_sub Bks β).
    pose proof (gsub_rel_ctx_wf _ _ _ Hβ) as HΨ.
    destruct (block_of_nblk D Bks Hdt HBks _ _ HMj Hrv) as [b Hb].
    assert (HUl0 : List.length Us0 = ind_nu D) by (unfold Us0; rewrite List.length_map; exact HUl).
    assert (HUs0 : forall k U T, List.nth_error Us0 k = Some U -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us0) k = Some T ->
               Ψ ⊨ U : T).
    { intros k U' T' HU HT; unfold Us0 in HU, HT.
      rewrite <- (tele_insts_sub (ind_uparams D) 0 Id Id β Us Ua (decl_uparams_closed D Hc) ltac:(intros; lia)) in HT.
      apply nth_error_map_inv in HU as (U & HU & ->); apply nth_error_map_inv in HT as (T & HT & ->).
      exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub Hβ (HUs _ _ _ HU HT)). }
    assert (HUU0 : forall k U U' T, List.nth_error Us0 k = Some U -> List.nth_error Us0 k = Some U' ->
               List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us0) k = Some T -> Ψ ⊨ U ≈ U' : T).
    { intros * HU HU' HT; rewrite HU in HU'; injection HU' as <-; exact (HUs0 _ _ _ HU HT). }
    assert (HBks0 : List.length Bks0 = ind_nblk D) by (unfold Bks0; rewrite length_blocks_sub; exact HBks).
    assert (Hgm : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> gsub (elim_mctx p D k Mk Us0 ++ Ψ) (sb_qn (S (im_nn Mk)) β) (elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ)).
    { intros * HMk.
      pose proof (gsub_qn _ _ _ _ Hβ (elim_mctx_ass p D k Mk Us Hc HMk) (HMall _ _ HMk)) as G.
      rewrite (elim_mctx_sub p D k Mk Us β Hc HMk HUl), length_elim_mctx in G; exact G. }
    assert (HMall0 : forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D k Mk Us0 ++ Ψ)
      by (intros * HMk; exact (gsub_rel_ctx_wf _ _ _ (Hgm _ _ HMk))).
    assert (HnmA0 : blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks0) by (apply blocks_binder_count_ok_sub; exact HnmA).
    assert (HAA0 : forall k Mk b1 b1', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1 -> List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1' ->
               elim_mctx p D k Mk Us0 ++ Ψ ⊨ eb_motive b1 ≈ eb_motive b1' : Typeω@i).
    { intros * HMk Hb1 Hb1'; rewrite Hb1 in Hb1'; injection Hb1' as <-.
      destruct (nth_error_blocks_sub_inv _ _ _ _ Hb1) as (b2 & Hb2 & ->).
      rewrite eb_motive_sub, (HnmA _ _ _ HMk Hb2).
      pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (Hgm _ _ HMk) (HAv _ _ _ HMk Hb2)) as H; cbn [exp_sub] in H; exact H. }
    assert (Hgb : forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
               gsub (elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks0) Us0 ++ Ψ)
                 (sb_qn (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mk) β) (elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ)).
    { intros * HMk Hcon.
      pose proof (gsub_qn _ _ _ _ Hβ (elim_bctx_ass ak_relevant p D k Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us Hc HMk) (HBc _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon)) as G.
      rewrite (elim_bctx_sub ak_relevant p D k Mk c gs (blocks_motives Bks) (blocks_motives Bks0) Us β Hc HMk (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) HUl
                 (fun j0 Mj0 HMj0 => blocks_motives_sub D Bks β j0 Mj0 HnmA HMj0)), length_elim_bctx in G.
      exact G. }
    assert (HBc0 : forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
               ⊨ elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks0) Us0 ++ Ψ)
      by (intros * HMk Hcon; exact (gsub_rel_ctx_wf _ _ _ (Hgb _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon))).
    assert (HnaA0 : forall k Mk b1, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1 -> brs_names (im_cons Mk) (eb_brs b1)).
    { intros * HMk Hb1; destruct (nth_error_blocks_sub_inv _ _ _ _ Hb1) as (b2 & Hb2 & ->).
      rewrite eb_brs_sub; apply brs_names_sub; exact (HnaA _ _ _ HMk Hb2). }
    assert (HarA0 : forall k Mk b1 c gs n B, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1 -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
               In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b1) -> n = (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat).
    { intros * HMk Hb1 Hcon Hin; destruct (nth_error_blocks_sub_inv _ _ _ _ Hb1) as (b2 & Hb2 & ->).
      rewrite eb_brs_sub in Hin; destruct (brs_in_sub _ _ _ _ _ Hin) as [B0 Hin0]; exact (HarA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb2 Hcon Hin0). }
    assert (HBB0 : forall k Mk b1 b1' c gs n B B', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1 ->
               List.nth_error Bks0 k = Some b1' -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
               brs_lookup (eb_brs b1) c = Some (n, B) -> brs_lookup (eb_brs b1') c = Some (n, B') ->
               elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mk gs (blocks_motives Bks0) Us0 ++ Ψ ⊨ B ≈ B' : elim_branch_type p D k Mk c gs (eb_motive b1) Us0).
    { intros * HMk Hb1 Hb1' Hcon Hlk Hlk'; rewrite Hb1 in Hb1'; injection Hb1' as <-; rewrite Hlk in Hlk'; injection Hlk' as <-.
      destruct (nth_error_blocks_sub_inv _ _ _ _ Hb1) as (b2 & Hb2 & ->).
      rewrite eb_brs_sub in Hlk; destruct (brs_lookup_sub_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hlk) as (B0 & Hlk0 & ->).
      pose proof (HarA _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb2 Hcon (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hlk0)) as ->.
      pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (Hgb _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon) (HBv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb2 Hcon (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hlk0))) as H.
      replace (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mk) with (im_nn Mk + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs) in H by lia.
      rewrite (elim_branch_type_sub p D k Mk c gs _ Us β Hc HMk HUl) in H.
      rewrite eb_motive_sub, (HnmA _ _ _ HMk Hb2); exact H. }
    assert (Hb0 : List.nth_error Bks0 j = Some (eblock_sub b β)) by (unfold Bks0; rewrite nth_error_blocks_sub, Hb; reflexivity).
    pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_elim_at VP p D HP HPD Ψ j Mj (eblock_sub b β) Bks0 Bks0 Us0 Us0 Ns M M i HΨ
                  HMj Hb0 HBks0 HBks0 HUl0 HUs0 HUs0s HUl0 HUs0s HUU0 HNl HNs HNss HM HMs HnmA0 HnmA0 HMall0 HAA0 HnaA0
                  (fun _ _ _ H1 H2 => ltac:(rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <-; reflexivity)) HBc0 HarA0 HBB0) as H.
    rewrite eb_motive_sub, (HnmA _ _ _ HMj Hb) in H.
    replace (S (im_nn Mj)) with (List.length (Ns ++ M :: nil)) in H by (rewrite List.length_app, HNl; cbn; lia).
    rewrite exp_sub_qn_of_list in H.
    rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hb); exact H.
  Qed.

The Recursive Results, Typed

The recursive result along a leaf path of a frame's shape, past kd of its domains, is of the type of the result along it: the eliminator's blocks moved past the frame's base and the domains. By strong induction on the member bounding the record view the shape ends in, and on the domains left.
  Lemma leaf_ih_valid : forall n k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk ck = Some gk ->
      gk = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      forall Mj, ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj -> (im_is_rview Mj = true -> ptyp_mem t < n) ->
      forall Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0, sem_frame p D Γ Us Mk gs1 t Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 ->
      forall kd l, kd <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) ->
      In l (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + kd) (ptyp_skip kd t)) ->
      (tele_sub (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t))) σ0 ++ Ψ0 ++ Γ
         ⊨ leaf_ih ak_relevant p (List.map (fun U => U[sb_shift_iter kd β0]) Us) (blocks_sub Bks (sb_shift_iter kd β0))
             (sb_qn kd σ0) (apps_vars_iter kd x0) l
         : leaf_ihty ak_relevant (blocks_motives Bks) (sb_shift_iter kd β0) (sb_qn kd σ0) (apps_vars_iter kd x0) l) /\
      (exists j0 : nat, tele_sub (doms_ctx (List.firstn kd (ptyp_doms t))) σ0 ++ Ψ0 ++ Γ
         ⊨ leaf_ihty ak_relevant (blocks_motives Bks) (sb_shift_iter kd β0) (sb_qn kd σ0) (apps_vars_iter kd x0) l : Typeω@j0).
  Proof.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HΓ) as [RΓ HRΓ].
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HD)) as [RU HRU].
    induction n as [n IHn] using Wf_nat.lt_wf_ind.
    intros k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0 Mj HMj Hrk Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf kd.
    remember (List.length (ptyp_doms t) - kd) as mm eqn:Hm; revert kd Hm.
    induction mm as [| mm IHm]; intros kd Hm l Hk Hin.
    - assert (kd = List.length (ptyp_doms t)) as -> by lia.
      rewrite (ptyp_skip_end t) in Hin; cbn [shape_leaves] in Hin.
      rewrite <- (frame_doms_tele VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                    Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
      destruct (im_is_rview Mj) eqn:Hrv.
      +
A record view: on to the frame of the field the path projects.
        specialize (Hrk eq_refl).
        destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc k' Is0 vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; rewrite Hh in Hrv;
          try discriminate.
        destruct (rview_struct_con _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ Hdt) _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as (gsr & Hcs & Hlen).
        pose proof (leaves_coherent_of_order _ (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ Hdt))) as Hco.
        rewrite (Hco _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hcs) in Hin.
        apply List.in_map_iff in Hin as (l0 & <- & Hin0).
        rewrite leaf_ih_wk, leaf_ihty_wk.
        apply fields_leaves_in in Hin0 as (fs1 & f & tf & fs2 & l1 & Ec & -> & Hin1).
        cbn [leaf_ih leaf_ihty List.app] in Hin1 |- *.
        pose proof (record_view_step_frame VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                      Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hh Hcs Ec) as Hf'; cbv zeta in Hf'.
        destruct (combine_split_at _ _ _ _ _ _ (eq_sym Hlen) Ec) as [Efl Egs].
        pose proof (ind_con_single _ _ _ Hcs) as Hcon'.
        destruct (rview_params _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hdt HMj Hh) as [_ Hnn].
        destruct (length_rec_ps D HD _ _ HMj _ _ _ _ _ Hcon' Egs) as (Mt & HMt & _).
        assert (Hrk' : im_is_rview Mt = true -> ptyp_mem tf < ptyp_mem t)
          by (intros HrT; exact (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ Hdt) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hcs Egs HMt HrT)).
        set (σv := ι (wk_shiftn (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + List.length (ptyp_doms t))) ⨟ sb_qn (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) σ0).
        assert (Eσ : sb_eq (sb_of_list σv (projections_of (fields_args fs1) (apps_vars_iter (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) x0)))
                       (ι (wk_pat (cargs_pat (List.map snd fs1)))
                          ⨟ sb_of_list σv (projections_of (List.map fst fs1) (apps_vars_iter (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) x0)))).
        { pose proof (wk_pat_projections fs1 nil σv (apps_vars_iter (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) x0)) as E.
          rewrite List.app_nil_r in E; symmetry; etransitivity; [ exact E |]; apply sb_of_list_cong; intros z; reflexivity. }
        rewrite (leaf_ih_sb_eq _ _ l1 _ _ _ _ _ Eσ), (leaf_ihty_sb_eq _ l1 _ _ (sb_shift_iter (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) β0) _ _ _ (reflexivity _) Eσ).
        assert (Hin1' : In l1 (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mj + List.length (cargs_nonrec (List.map snd fs1)) + 0) (ptyp_skip 0 tf))).
        { replace (im_nn Mj + List.length (cargs_nonrec (List.map snd fs1)) + 0) with (List.length (fields_args fs1)); [ exact Hin1 |].
          rewrite Hnn; clear; induction fs1 as [| [? []] fs1 IH]; cbn [List.map snd fields_args cargs_nonrec]; cbn [List.length]; lia. }
        pose proof (IHn (ptyp_mem t) Hrk (ptyp_mem t) Mj rview_con gsr (List.map snd fs1) tf (List.map snd fs2) HMj Hcon' Egs Mt HMt Hrk'
                      _ _ _ _ Hf' 0 l1 (Nat.le_0_l _) Hin1') as H.
        cbn [List.firstn doms_ctx List.map List.rev tele_sub List.app sb_shift_iter sb_qn apps_vars_iter] in H.
        rewrite <- List.app_assoc in H; exact H.
      +
A member with a block: its eliminator.
        rewrite (rview_leaves_not_rview _ _ _ HMj Hrv) in Hin; destruct Hin as [<- | []].
        cbn [leaf_ih leaf_ihty].
        split.
        2:{
Its type: the motive at the end's substitution.
            exists i; destruct (block_of_nblk D Bks Hdt HBks _ _ HMj Hrv) as [bj Hbj].
            rewrite (blocks_motives_nth _ _ _ Hbj).
            pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (frame_gsub_leaf VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2
                                                  HMk Hck Heq0 Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj) (HAv _ _ _ HMj Hbj)) as H.
            cbn [exp_sub] in H; exact H. }
        apply (elim_moved_valid _ _ (ptyp_mem t) Mj _ _
                 (frame_gsub_end_base VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                    Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj) HMj Hrv).
        * pose proof (uparams_wk_scoped _ _ (frame_end_base_eq VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2
                                               HMk Hck Heq0 Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj)) as H.
          rewrite List.app_assoc, (List.length_app _ Γ); exact H.
        * rewrite List.length_map; exact (frame_end_params_len VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2
                                             HMk Hck Heq0 Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
        * apply (frame_end_params_each VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                   Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
          intros y Hy; cbn [sb_compose].
          rewrite sb_of_list_map by (rewrite HUl; lia); rewrite <- sentry_exp_sub; reflexivity.
        * exact (frame_end_params_scoped VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                   Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
        * exact (frame_end_arg_typed VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                   Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
        * exact (frame_end_arg_scoped VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0
                   Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf Mj HMj).
    -
At a domain.
      assert (Hk' : kd < List.length (ptyp_doms t)) by lia.
      destruct (ptyp_skip_lt kd t Hk') as (Bk & HBk & Hs).
      rewrite Hs in Hin; cbn [shape_leaves] in Hin.
      apply List.in_map_iff in Hin as (l' & <- & Hin').
      cbn [leaf_ih leaf_ihty].
      destruct (valid_ind_decl_dom _ HD k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 kd Bk HMk Hck Heq0 HBk) as (_ & j & HBv0).
      rewrite <- (frame_nonrec_ctx VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0) in HBv0.
      pose proof (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _
                    (frame_doms_ass VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0 kd)
                    (frame_doms_valid VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0 kd
                       ltac:(lia)) HΓ HBv0) as HBv1.
      rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HBv1.
      pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (frame_gsub_doms_at VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2
                                            HMk Hck Heq0 Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf kd ltac:(lia)) HBv1) as HBk'; cbn [exp_sub] in HBk'.
      assert (HUs1 : List.map (fun U => U[↑]ʷ) (List.map (fun U => U[sb_shift_iter kd β0]) Us)
                     = List.map (fun U => U[sb_shift_iter (S kd) β0]) Us)
        by (rewrite List.map_map; apply List.map_ext; intros; rewrite <- exp_sub_of_wk, exp_sub_sub; reflexivity).
      assert (HBs1 : blocks_wk (blocks_sub Bks (sb_shift_iter kd β0)) ↑ = blocks_sub Bks (sb_shift_iter (S kd) β0))
        by (rewrite <- blocks_sub_of_wk, blocks_sub_sub; reflexivity).
      rewrite HUs1, HBs1.
      assert (Hin'' : In l' (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + S kd) (ptyp_skip (S kd) t)))
        by (replace (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + S kd) with (S (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + kd)) by lia;
            exact Hin').
      pose proof (IHm (S kd) ltac:(lia) l' ltac:(lia) Hin'') as H.
      rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ HBk), doms_ctx_snoc in H; cbn [tele_sub List.app centry_sub] in H.
      rewrite (frame_doms_len VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss HMall k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0 kd ltac:(lia)) in H.
      destruct H as [Hih [j0 Hty]].
The domain and the rest's type at a common universe.
      pose proof (rel_exp_cumu_ge (Nat.le_max_l j j0) HBk') as HBm.
      pose proof (rel_exp_cumu_ge (Nat.le_max_r j j0) Hty) as Htm.
      split.
      + exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_fn_cong (rel_type_of_typ HBm) (rel_type_of_typ HBm) (rel_type_kind_of_typ HBm) Htm Hih).
      + exists (Nat.max j j0);
          exact (rel_exp_under_ctx_pi_cong (rel_type_of_typ HBm) (rel_type_of_typ HBm) (rel_type_kind_of_typ HBm) Htm).
  Qed.
End Blocks.

The Recursive Results as Terms, along a Recursive Argument

The group's blocks Bks valid at the uniform parameters Us over Γ, at an environment C of Γ: walking the leaf paths of a recursive argument in a frame, the values of the recursive results as terms (leaf_ih) against the eliminator's own recursive results at a related argument.
Section LeafVals.
  #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hl := valid_group_lookup _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Ua : all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) := uparams_ass D Hc.

  Variable (Γ : ctx) (Us : list exp) (Bks : list eblock) (i : nat).

The blocks of the members with one.

  Lemma uparams_have_types : forall j U, List.nth_error Us j = Some U -> exists T, Γ ⊨ U : T.

  Qed.

The Link of a Term to a Recursive Argument

A term x over C extended by the typed values yts, that is a recursive argument related to v whenever moved past further typed values zts that some context of Γ's weakening relates to themselves: its value there is related to v at the shape t, after the components pre of the telescope Ts. The term is any term, its value under a weakening not the same as its own: a proof kept in it closes over the environment it is evaluated in.
  Definition iota_arg_link (k : nat) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (t : ptyp) (v : domain) (x : exp)
      (yts : list (domain * entry_type)) : Prop :=
    forall Δ RΔ zts, EF Δ ≈ Δ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΔ ->
      Δ ⊨ˢ sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (List.length yts + List.length zts)) ≈ sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (List.length yts + List.length zts)) : Γ ->
      RΔ (env_extend_typed C (yts ++ zts)) (env_extend_typed C (yts ++ zts)) ->
      exists pre0 m0, ⟦ x[wk_shiftn (List.length zts)]ʷ ⟧ env_extend_typed C (yts ++ zts) ↘ m0 /\
        rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre0 Ts t v m0.

What the walk along a recursive argument gives: the values of the recursive results as terms (leaf_ih) at an environment, the eliminator's own recursive results at the related argument v', and their relation, the canonical argument v on the left.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record leaf_ihs_vals_out (k : nat) (pre pre' : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (t : ptyp) (v v' : domain) (E : env)
      (Us0 : list exp) (Bks0 : list eblock) (σ : sub) (x : exp) (mk : nat) : Prop := mk_leaf_ihs_vals_out
    {
The values of the recursive results as terms
      leaf_ihs_vals_terms : list domain
      
The eliminator's own recursive results at v'
    ; leaf_ihs_vals_own : list domain
      
The terms', at E
    ; leaf_ihs_vals_eval_terms :
        ⟦ List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us0 Bks0 σ x) (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) mk t) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ E ↘ leaf_ihs_vals_terms
      
The eliminator's own, at C
    ; leaf_ihs_vals_eval_own : ⟦ih v' of t under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ leaf_ihs_vals_own
      
Related along the leaf paths
    ; leaf_ihs_vals_related : rec_result_rel D dr Rel k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts t v v' leaf_ihs_vals_terms leaf_ihs_vals_own }.

Along a Leaf Path

A canonical recursive argument v of the shape t of a frame, past kd of its domains at the values of yts on the terms' side and ys2 on the other, related to v' and linked to the frame's argument past the domains, over C extended by the frame's base values zts and yts: the values of the terms and the recursive results at v' are related. The frame's canonical arguments ns and cv are related to its stored ones, X and nv. By strong induction on the member bounding the record view the shape ends in, and on the domains left.
  Lemma leaf_ihs_vals : forall n k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk ck = Some gk ->
      gk = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      forall Mj, ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj -> (im_is_rview Mj = true -> ptyp_mem t < n) ->
      forall Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0, sem_frame p D Γ Us Mk gs1 t Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 -> forall RΨ, EF Ψ0 ++ Γ ≈ Ψ0 ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΨ ->
      forall ns cv zts w X nv vx, sem_frame_vals D Γ RΓ RU C u0 Mk gs1 Ψ0 σ0 x0 RΨ (env_extend_typed C zts) C zts w X nv vx ->
      tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns X -> tele_prefix_rel (ar k ns ck) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) cv nv ->
      forall kd yts ys2 v v' pre2, kd <= List.length (ptyp_doms t) -> List.length yts = kd ->
      List.Forall (fun vt => entry_readable (de_term (fst vt) (snd vt))) yts ->
      tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ns cv t) kd (List.map fst yts) ys2 ->
      rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 (ns ++ cv ++ List.map fst yts) (pre2 ++ ys2)
        (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kd (shape_doms_tele t)) (ptyp_skip kd t) v v' ->
      iota_arg_link k (ns ++ cv ++ List.map fst yts)
        (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kd (shape_doms_tele t)) (ptyp_skip kd t) v
        (apps_vars_iter kd x0) (zts ++ yts) ->
      leaf_ihs_vals_out k (ns ++ cv ++ List.map fst yts) (pre2 ++ ys2)
        (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kd (shape_doms_tele t)) (ptyp_skip kd t) v v'
        (env_extend_typed C (zts ++ yts))
        (List.map (fun U => U[sb_shift_iter kd β0]) Us) (blocks_sub Bks (sb_shift_iter kd β0)) (sb_qn kd σ0) (apps_vars_iter kd x0)
        (im_nn Mk + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + kd).
  Proof.
    assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
    pose proof (leaves_coherent_of_order _ (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ Hdt))) as Hco.
    induction n as [n IHn] using Wf_nat.lt_wf_ind.
    intros k Mk ck gk gs1 t gs2 HMk Hck Heq0 Mj HMj Hrk Ψ0 σ0 β0 x0 Hf RΨ HRΨ ns cv zts w X nv vx Hv HX Hcv kd.
    set (T := List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) in *.
    set (K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) in *.

    induction mm as [| mm IHm]; intros kd Hm yts ys2 v v' pre2 Hk Lys Hry Hys Hsh Hlk.

At the end of the shape: the environment of its end context, and the term's value there.

The Sorts of the Entries of a Branch's Context

The branch's context of a constructor c of the member m, at valid blocks Bks and uniform parameters Us over Γ: each entry is a type of a universe of its sort, a recursive result's and a parameter's the relevant one, an argument's its own. Used by the rule (Iota) and by the view's wrapped branches (ElimView).
Section BranchSorts.
  #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let Hcv := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Ua : all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) := uparams_ass D Hc.
  Let Usem : ⊨ ind_uparams D := valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HD.

  Variable (Γ : ctx) (Us : list exp) (Bks : list eblock) (i : nat).
  Hypotheses (HΓ : ⊨ Γ) (HUl : List.length Us = ind_nu D)
    (HUs : forall k U T, List.nth_error Us k = Some U -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) k = Some T -> Γ ⊨ U : T)
    (HUss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Us)
    (HBks : List.length Bks = ind_nblk D)
    (HnmA : blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks)
    (HMall : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ)
    (HAv : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
             elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b : Typeω@i)
    (HnaA : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mj) (eb_brs b))
    (HBc : forall j Mj c gs, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             ⊨ elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ)
    (HarA : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
              In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mj + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat)
    (HBv : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
             elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ ⊨ B : elim_branch_type p D j Mj c gs (eb_motive b) Us).
  Let HBks' := block_of_nblk D Bks Hdt HBks.

  Variable (m : nat) (Mm : imember) (c : String.string) (gs : list carg).
  Hypotheses (HMm : ind_member D m = Some Mm) (Hcon : ind_con Mm c = Some gs).

The recursive results of the arguments gs1 before the others, over the instance of the arguments and the non-uniform parameters, form a valid context.
  Lemma recursive_results_prefix_valid : forall gs1 gs2, gs = gs1 ++ gs2 ->
      ⊨ ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs.
  Proof.
    intros * Heq; pose proof (HBc _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon) as H; unfold elim_bctx in H.
    replace (ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs)
      with (ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1 ++ nil) (0 + cargs_nrec D gs1) gs2
              ++ ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1) in H
      by (rewrite <- ihs_ctx_aux_app, <- Heq; reflexivity).
    unfold con_inst_ctx; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in H; exact (rel_ctx_wf_app_r _ _ H).
  Qed.

The recursive results of a recursive argument t after gs1, one per leaf path of its shape, as a context: after those of gs1.
  Lemma recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument : forall gs1 t,
      ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil)
      = leaves_ctx ak_relevant (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (cargs_nrec D gs1)
          (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) t)
        ++ ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1.
  Proof.
    intros gs1 t; rewrite ihs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app Nat.add].
    replace (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + im_nn Mm) with (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))
      by (rewrite pat_nargs_cargs_pat, cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele; lia).
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

The kind of an entry of the arguments and the non-uniform parameters, at Us: an argument's own, a recursive one's and a parameter's ak_relevant. y counts the entries from the last argument.
  Definition instance_entry_kind (y : nat) : abs_kind :=
    if y <? List.length gs then
      match List.nth_error gs (List.length gs - 1 - y) with Some (ca_arg r _) => r | _ => ak_relevant end
    else ak_relevant.

An entry over the uniform parameters, of a sort, moved by Us.
  Lemma closed_entry_moved : forall X2 A (S : exp), all_assumptions X2 -> ⊨ X2 ++ ind_uparams D ->
      (forall σ, S[σ] = S) -> X2 ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : S ->
      tele_sub X2 (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ ⊨ A[sb_qn (List.length X2) (sb_of_list Id Us)] : S.
  Proof.
    intros * HXa HX HS HA.
    assert (HXUa : all_assumptions (X2 ++ ind_uparams D)) by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HXa | exact Ua ]).
    pose proof (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ HXUa HX HΓ HA) as HAΓ; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HAΓ.
    destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HXUa HX HΓ) as [HXΓ _]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HXΓ.
    pose proof (gsub_qn X2 Γ (sb_of_list Id Us) (ind_uparams D ++ Γ)
                  (gsub_closed_inst _ _ _ Ua Usem HΓ HUl HUs HUss) HXa HXΓ) as Hg.
    pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub Hg HAΓ) as H; rewrite HS in H; exact H.
  Qed.

  Lemma abs_kind_sort_universe_sub : forall r (j : nat) σ, (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@j)[σ] = abs_kind_sort r Typeω@j.
  Proof. intros [] *; reflexivity. Qed.

  Lemma instance_entry_sort : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ im_nparams Mm) (sb_of_list Id Us) = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
      exists i : nat, Δ2 ++ Γ ⊨ T : abs_kind_sort (instance_entry_kind (List.length Δ1)) Typeω@i.
  Proof.
    intros * H.
    assert (HXa : all_assumptions (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ im_nparams Mm))
      by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (decl_closed_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMm) ]).
    destruct (tele_sub_split_at _ _ _ _ _ _ HXa H) as (X1 & A & X2 & EX & L1 & -> & ->).
    rewrite <- L1.
    assert (HX2a : all_assumptions X2) by (rewrite EX in HXa; apply List.Forall_app in HXa as [_ HXa]; exact (List.Forall_inv_tail HXa)).
The entry's sort over the uniform parameters.
    assert (Hsort : exists i : nat, ⊨ X2 ++ ind_uparams D /\ X2 ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : abs_kind_sort (instance_entry_kind (List.length X1)) Typeω@i).
    { destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases (List.length X1) (List.length gs)) as [Hy | Hy].
      -
An argument.
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs (List.length gs - 1 - List.length X1) ltac:(lia)) as [g Hg].
        destruct (List.nth_error_split _ _ Hg) as (a & b & Hgs & La).
        assert (Lb : List.length b = List.length X1)
          by (pose proof (f_equal (@List.length _) Hgs) as Lg; rewrite List.length_app in Lg; cbn [List.length] in Lg; lia).
        destruct (valid_group_cargs_sem_all p D Hvg Hcv m Mm c gs HMm Hcon a (g :: b) Hgs) as [HΨa IHw].
        assert (Hrf : instance_entry_kind (List.length X1) = match g with ca_arg r _ => r | ca_rec _ => ak_relevant end).
        { unfold instance_entry_kind; replace (List.length X1 <? List.length gs) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; exact Hy).
          rewrite Hg; destruct g; reflexivity. }
        rewrite Hrf.
        assert (EX' : cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ im_nparams Mm
                      = cargs_ctx_aux p D (im_nn Mm) (cargs_pat (g :: nil) ++ cargs_pat a) b
                          ++ (cargs_ctx_aux p D (im_nn Mm) (cargs_pat a) (g :: nil)) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mm a ++ im_nparams Mm).
        { unfold cargs_ctx; rewrite Hgs, cargs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r.
          change (g :: b) with ((g :: nil) ++ b); rewrite cargs_ctx_aux_app, <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity. }
        assert (Lpre : List.length (cargs_ctx_aux p D (im_nn Mm) (cargs_pat (g :: nil) ++ cargs_pat a) b) = List.length X1)
          by (rewrite length_cargs_ctx_aux; exact Lb).
        destruct g as [r A0 | t].
        + cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in EX'.
          rewrite EX in EX'; destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ EX' (eq_sym Lpre)) as [_ E2].
          cbn [List.app] in E2; injection E2 as -> -> ->.
          assert (HA : List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gs) (List.length (cargs_nonrec a)) = Some A0)
            by (rewrite Hgs, cargs_nonrec_app, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
          pose proof (nonrec_kind_at a b r A0) as Hr; rewrite <- Hgs in Hr.
          destruct (valid_ind_decl_arg _ HD _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon HA Hr) as (_ & j & HA0).
          rewrite Hgs, <- cargs_nonrec_ctx_nonrec_args_prefix in HA0.
          pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_wk IHw HA0) as HAw; cbn [exp_wk] in HAw.
          rewrite abs_kind_sort_wk in HAw; cbn [exp_wk] in HAw.
          exists j; split; [ rewrite <- List.app_assoc; unfold im_params in HΨa; exact HΨa |].
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc; unfold im_params in HAw; exact HAw.
        + cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in EX'.
          rewrite EX in EX'; destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ EX' (eq_sym Lpre)) as [_ E2].
          cbn [List.app] in E2; injection E2 as -> -> ->.
The recursive argument's type, the Π over its domains of the end.
          rewrite (ptyp_ty_ctx_pi p D (im_nn Mm) t (cargs_pat a)).
          assert (HΦa : all_assumptions (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat a) (ptyp_doms t))) by apply shape_domains_ctx_ass.
          assert (HΦ : ⊨ shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat a) (ptyp_doms t) ++ cargs_ctx p D Mm a ++ im_params D Mm).
          { pose proof (shape_domains_ctx_sem_gen D p m Mm c gs HD HMm Hcon a t b Hgs HΨa IHw _ (le_n _)) as H0.
            rewrite List.firstn_all in H0; exact H0. }
          destruct (valid_group_shape_leaf p D Hvg Hcv m Mm c gs a t b HMm Hcon Hgs HΨa IHw) as [j0 Hleaf].
          destruct (rel_exp_ctx_pi _ _ _ _ HΦa HΦ Hleaf) as [j Hj].
          exists j; split; [ rewrite <- List.app_assoc; unfold im_params in HΨa; exact HΨa |].
          rewrite <- List.app_assoc; unfold im_params in Hj; exact Hj.
      -
A non-uniform parameter.
        assert (Lc : List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs) <= List.length X1) by (rewrite length_cargs_ctx; exact Hy).
        destruct (app_split_prefix _ _ _ _ EX Lc) as (X1' & -> & Enp).
        assert (Hrf : instance_entry_kind (List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ X1')) = ak_relevant).
        { unfold instance_entry_kind; replace (List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ X1') <? List.length gs) with false
            by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_ge; rewrite List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx; lia).
          reflexivity. }
        rewrite Hrf; cbn [abs_kind_sort].
        assert (Ep : im_params D Mm = X1' ++ ce_ass κ A :: (X2 ++ ind_uparams D))
          by (unfold im_params; rewrite Enp, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
        destruct (im_nparams_typed D HD m Mm HMm X1' κ A X2 Enp) as [j Hj].
        exists j; split; [| exact Hj ].
        pose proof (valid_ind_decl_params _ HD _ _ HMm) as HP0; rewrite Ep in HP0.
        exact (rel_ctx_wf_tail (rel_ctx_wf_app_r _ _ HP0)). }
    destruct Hsort as (j & HX & HAj).
    exists j; exact (closed_entry_moved X2 A _ HX2a HX (abs_kind_sort_universe_sub _ _) HAj).
  Qed.

The sort of an entry of the branch's context: a recursive result's and a parameter's the relevant one, an argument's its own.
  Definition branch_context_entry_kind (x : nat) : abs_kind :=
    if x <? cargs_nrec D gs then ak_relevant else instance_entry_kind (x - cargs_nrec D gs).

At an environment of Γ, the recursive results' sorts, by the frame of each recursive argument.
  Section Sem.
    Variable (RΓ RU : relation env).
    Hypotheses (HRΓ : EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ) (HRU : EF ind_uparams D ≈ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RU).
    Variable (C : env) (u0 : list domain).
    Hypotheses (HCC : RΓ C C) (HUC : ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ u0) (HrvM : im_is_rview Mm = false).
    #[local] Abbreviation EP f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs HUss C u0 HCC HUC C HCC Bks i HBks' HMall HAv).

Each entry of the recursive results is a type of a universe, over the entries after it: the type of the result along its leaf path, in the frame of its argument (leaf_ih_valid).
    Lemma recursive_results_entry_sort : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2,
        ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
        exists j0 : nat, Δ2 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs ⊨ T : Typeω@j0.
    Proof.
      assert (Hgen : forall kk, kk <= List.length gs -> forall Δ1 κ T Δ2,
                 ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 (List.firstn kk gs)
                 = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> exists j0 : nat, Δ2 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs ⊨ T : Typeω@j0).
      { induction kk as [| kk IH]; intros Hk Δ1 κ T Δ2 H; [ cbn in H; destruct Δ1; discriminate |].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs kk ltac:(lia)) as [g Hg].
        rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hg) in H.
        assert (Heq0 : gs = List.firstn kk gs ++ g :: List.skipn (S kk) gs)
          by (rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hg), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
        destruct g as [r B0 | t].
        - rewrite ihs_ctx_aux_app in H; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app] in H; exact (IH ltac:(lia) _ _ _ _ H).
        - rewrite recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument in H.
          set (gs1 := List.firstn kk gs) in *; set (gs2 := List.skipn (S kk) gs) in *.
          set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) t) in *.
          set (Lv := leaves_ctx ak_relevant (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (cargs_nrec D gs1) ls) in *.
          set (E0 := ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1) in *.
          destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases (List.length Δ1) (List.length Lv)) as [Hlt | Hge].
          + destruct (app_split_prefix Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) Lv E0 (eq_sym H) ltac:(lia)) as (m1 & ELv & Em).
            destruct m1 as [| d m1]; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r in ELv; rewrite ELv in Hlt; lia |].
            cbn [List.app] in Em; injection Em as <- ->.
            destruct (leaves_ctx_split_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ELv) as (n & l & Hn & -> & Em1).
            set (Er := m1 ++ E0).
The context past the entry is valid.
            assert (HCtx : ⊨ Er ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs).
            { pose proof (recursive_results_prefix_valid (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) gs2 ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq0)) as HC.
              rewrite recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument in HC; fold ls Lv E0 in HC.
              rewrite ELv, <- !List.app_assoc in HC; cbn [List.app] in HC.
              apply rel_ctx_wf_app_r in HC; unfold Er; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact (rel_ctx_wf_tail HC). }
            assert (Hnl : n < List.length ls) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
            assert (LEr : List.length Er = cargs_nrec D gs1 + n)
              by (unfold Er, E0; rewrite Em1, List.length_app, length_leaves_ctx, List.length_firstn, length_ihs_ctx_aux; lia).
The entry's argument, in its frame.
            pose proof (EP branch_entry_frame m Mm c gs HMm Hcon (HBc _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon) HrvM gs1 t gs2 Heq0 Er HCtx) as Hf.
            destruct (length_rec_ps D HD m Mm HMm c gs gs1 t gs2 Hcon Heq0) as (Mj & HMj & _).
            assert (Hin : In l (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + 0) (ptyp_skip 0 t)))
              by (rewrite Nat.add_0_r; cbn [ptyp_skip]; exact (List.nth_error_In _ _ Hn)).
            destruct (leaf_ih_valid VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks i HΓ HUl HUs HUss HBks HnmA HMall HAv HnaA HBc
                        HarA HBv (S (ptyp_mem t)) m Mm c gs gs1 t gs2 HMm Hcon Heq0 Mj HMj (fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_diag_r _)
                        _ _ _ _ Hf 0 l (Nat.le_0_l _) Hin) as [_ (j0 & Hty)].
            cbn [List.firstn doms_ctx List.map List.rev tele_sub List.app sb_shift_iter sb_qn apps_vars_iter] in Hty.
            rewrite LEr in Hty.
            exists j0; unfold Er in Hty; rewrite con_inst_ctx_eq, List.app_assoc; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Hty |- *.
            exact Hty.
          + destruct (app_split_prefix Lv E0 Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) H Hge) as (m1 & -> & Em).
            exact (IH ltac:(lia) _ _ _ _ Em). }
      intros Δ1 κ T Δ2 H; apply (Hgen (List.length gs) (le_n _) Δ1 κ); rewrite List.firstn_all; exact H.
    Qed.

    Lemma branch_context_entry_sort : forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
        exists i0 : nat, Δ2 ++ Γ ⊨ T : abs_kind_sort (branch_context_entry_kind (List.length Δ1)) Typeω@i0.
    Proof.
      intros * E.
      set (IHs := ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs) in *.
      set (Inst := tele_sub (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs ++ im_nparams Mm) (sb_of_list Id Us)).
      assert (EK : elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us = IHs ++ Inst)
        by (unfold elim_bctx, Inst; rewrite tele_sub_app, length_im_nparams; reflexivity).
      assert (LI : List.length IHs = cargs_nrec D gs) by apply length_ihs_ctx_aux.
      rewrite EK in E.
      destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases (List.length Δ1) (List.length IHs)) as [Hlt | Hge].
      - destruct (app_split_prefix Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) IHs Inst (eq_sym E) ltac:(lia)) as (m1 & EI & Em).
        destruct m1 as [| d m1]; [ rewrite List.app_nil_r in EI; rewrite EI in Hlt; lia |].
        cbn [List.app] in Em; injection Em as <- ->.
        destruct (recursive_results_entry_sort Δ1 κ T m1 EI) as [j0 Hj0].
        assert (Hrf : branch_context_entry_kind (List.length Δ1) = ak_relevant)
          by (unfold branch_context_entry_kind; replace (List.length Δ1 <? cargs_nrec D gs) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; lia); reflexivity).
        rewrite Hrf; exists j0; cbn [abs_kind_sort].
        rewrite con_inst_ctx_eq in Hj0; fold Inst in Hj0; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Hj0.
      - destruct (app_split_prefix IHs Inst Δ1 (ce_ass κ T :: Δ2) E Hge) as (m1 & -> & Em).
        destruct (instance_entry_sort m1 κ T Δ2 Em) as [i0 Hi0].
        assert (Hrf : branch_context_entry_kind (List.length (IHs ++ m1)) = instance_entry_kind (List.length m1)).
        { unfold branch_context_entry_kind; rewrite List.length_app, LI.
          replace (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length m1 <? cargs_nrec D gs) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_ge; lia).
          f_equal; lia. }
        rewrite Hrf; exists i0; exact Hi0.
    Qed.
  End Sem.
End BranchSorts.

The Rule

An eliminator of the member m at a constructor c of it, at the parameters Ps and the arguments As.
Section Iota.
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let Hcv := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hl := valid_group_lookup _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Ua : all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) := uparams_ass D Hc.
  Let Usem : ⊨ ind_uparams D := valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HD.

  Variable (Γ : ctx) (m : nat) (Mm : imember) (bm : eblock) (Bks : list eblock)
    (c : String.string) (gs : list carg) (Ps As : list exp) (i : nat).
  Let Us := List.firstn (ind_nu D) Ps.
  Let Ns := List.skipn (ind_nu D) Ps.
  Let σP := sb_of_list Id Ps.
  Hypotheses (HΓ : ⊨ Γ) (HMm : ind_member D m = Some Mm) (Hbm : List.nth_error Bks m = Some bm)
    (Hcon : ind_con Mm c = Some gs) (HPl : List.length Ps = im_np D Mm)
    (HPs : forall k P T, List.nth_error Ps k = Some P -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_params D Mm) Id Ps) k = Some T -> Γ ⊨ P : T)
    (HPss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Ps)
    (HAl : List.length As = List.length gs)
    (HAs : forall k N T, List.nth_error As k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs) σP As) k = Some T -> Γ ⊨ N : T)
    (HAss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) As)
    (HBss : blocks_scoped (List.length Γ) Bks)
    (HBks : List.length Bks = ind_nblk D)
    (HnmA : blocks_binder_count_ok D Bks)
    (HMall : forall j Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ⊨ elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ)
    (HAv : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b ->
             elim_mctx p D j Mj Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b : Typeω@i)
    (HnaA : forall j Mj b, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mj) (eb_brs b))
    (HBc : forall j Mj c gs, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             ⊨ elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ)
    (HarA : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
              In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mj + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat)
    (HBv : forall j Mj b c gs n B, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> List.nth_error Bks j = Some b -> ind_con Mj c = Some gs ->
             In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) ->
             elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mj gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ ⊨ B : elim_branch_type p D j Mj c gs (eb_motive b) Us).
  Let HΨ := valid_group_cargs_sem p D Hvg Hcv m Mm c gs HMm Hcon.
The member has a block: it is not a record view.
  Let HrvM := Elim.block_not_rview D Bks m Mm bm Hdt HBks HMm Hbm.
The blocks of the members with one.
  Let HBks' := block_of_nblk D Bks Hdt HBks.

  Lemma iota_case_HUl : List.length Us = ind_nu D.
  Proof. unfold Us; rewrite List.length_firstn; unfold im_np in HPl; lia. Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_HNl : List.length Ns = im_nn Mm.
  Proof. unfold Ns; rewrite List.length_skipn; unfold im_np in HPl; lia. Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_HUs : forall k U T, List.nth_error Us k = Some U -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) k = Some T -> Γ ⊨ U : T.
  Proof. exact (proj1 (params_valid_split D m Mm Γ Ps Hc HMm HPl HPs)). Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_HNs : forall k N T, List.nth_error Ns k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mm) (sb_of_list Id Us) Ns) k = Some T ->
      Γ ⊨ N : T.
  Proof. exact (proj2 (params_valid_split D m Mm Γ Ps Hc HMm HPl HPs)). Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_HUss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Us.
  Proof. exact (Forall_firstn' _ _ _ HPss). Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_HNss : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length Γ)) Ns.
  Proof. exact (Forall_skipn' _ _ _ HPss). Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_Ps : Ps = Us ++ Ns.
  Proof. symmetry; apply List.firstn_skipn. Qed.

  Lemma iota_case_Us_id : List.map (fun U => U[Id]) Us = Us.
  Proof. rewrite (List.map_ext _ (fun U => U) exp_sub_id); apply List.map_id. Qed.

The Parameters and the Arguments Before a Position

  Lemma gsub_P : gsub Γ σP (im_params D Mm ++ Γ).
  Proof.
    apply gsub_closed_inst; [ exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMm) | exact (valid_ind_decl_params _ HD _ _ HMm) | exact HΓ
                            | rewrite length_im_params; exact HPl | exact HPs | exact HPss ].
  Qed.

  Lemma gsub_args_pre : forall k, k <= List.length gs ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list σP (List.firstn k As)) (cargs_ctx p D Mm (List.firstn k gs) ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ).
  Proof.
    intros k Hk.
    assert (Heq : gs = List.firstn k gs ++ List.skipn k gs) by (symmetry; apply List.firstn_skipn).
    pose proof (cargs_prefix_sem D p Mm gs HΨ _ _ Heq) as Hp.
    assert (Hpa : all_assumptions (cargs_ctx p D Mm (List.firstn k gs) ++ im_params D Mm))
      by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMm) ]).
    destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ Hpa Hp HΓ) as [HpΓ _]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HpΓ.
    apply gsub_of_list; [ exact gsub_P | apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact HpΓ
                        | rewrite List.length_firstn, length_cargs_ctx, List.length_firstn; lia | | exact (Forall_firstn' _ _ _ HAss) ].
    intros j N T HN HT.
    assert (Hj : j < List.length (List.firstn k As)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    rewrite List.length_firstn in Hj.
    apply (HAs j); [ rewrite List.nth_error_firstn in HN; destruct (Nat.ltb_spec j k); [ exact HN | lia ] |].
    rewrite Heq at 1; unfold cargs_ctx; rewrite cargs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r.
    rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn k As), tele_insts_app;
      [| apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | rewrite List.length_firstn, length_cargs_ctx_aux, List.length_firstn; lia ].
    rewrite List.nth_error_app1; [ exact HT |].
    rewrite length_tele_insts by apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass; rewrite length_cargs_ctx_aux, !List.length_firstn; lia.
  Qed.

The substitution of a shape's components after gs1.
  Lemma gsub_sigt : forall gs1 gs2, gs = gs1 ++ gs2 ->
      gsub Γ (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ).
  Proof.
    intros * Heq.
    assert (Lg1 : List.length gs1 <= List.length gs) by (rewrite Heq, List.length_app; lia).
    pose proof (gsub_args_pre _ Lg1) as Hg.
    assert (Hfg : List.firstn (List.length gs1) gs = gs1) by (rewrite Heq; apply firstn_app_exact; reflexivity).
    rewrite Hfg in Hg.
    destruct (gsub_props Hg) as [Hgv Hgl].
    pose proof (cargs_prefix_sem D p Mm gs HΨ _ _ Heq) as Hp.
    assert (Hpa : all_assumptions (cargs_ctx p D Mm gs1 ++ im_params D Mm))
      by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMm) ]).
    destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ Hpa Hp HΓ) as [HpΓ _]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HpΓ.
    assert (HSa : all_assumptions (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm))
      by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ rewrite cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele; apply List.Forall_rev, all_assumptions_cargs_nonrec_tele
                                       | exact (member_params_ass D Hc _ _ HMm) ]).
    assert (HSs : ⊨ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm)
      by (rewrite (cargs_nonrec_ctx_nonrec_args_prefix gs1 gs2), <- Heq; apply (valid_ind_decl_nonrec_prefixes _ HD _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon);
          rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; lia).
    destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HSa HSs HΓ) as [HSΓ _]; rewrite <- List.app_assoc in HSΓ.
    pose proof (gsub_wk _ _ _ (cargs_wk_ext VP p D HP HPD Γ HΓ Us iota_case_HUl m Mm c gs HMm Hcon gs1 gs2 Heq) HpΓ HSΓ) as G0.
    eapply gsub_eq; [ exact (gsub_comp _ _ _ _ _ G0 HΓ Hgv Hgl) |].
    rewrite <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1 σP As).
    apply cargs_sub_pat; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia.
  Qed.

The Frame of a Recursive Argument

The recursive argument Mt of shape t after the arguments gs1: the frame of its position, over no context, at the components σt and the base Id.
  Section RecArg.
    #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
    Variable (gs1 : list carg) (t : ptyp) (gs2 : list carg).
    Hypothesis (Heq : gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2).
    Let σt := cargs_sub σP gs1 As.
    Let Mt := List.nth (List.length gs1) As (a_var 0).

    Lemma iota_rec_arg_uc : shape_uc D Us (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm) σt Id.
    Proof.
      intros y Hy.
      assert (Lg1 : List.length gs1 <= List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      unfold σt; rewrite <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1 σP As).
      rewrite <- (cargs_sub_pat gs1 σP (List.firstn (List.length gs1) As)) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      cbn [sb_compose sb_of_wk sentry_sub].
      replace (y + (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm) - ind_nu D)) with (pat_nargs (cargs_pat gs1) + (im_nn Mm + y))
        by (rewrite List.length_app, length_im_params, pat_nargs_cargs_pat; unfold im_np; lia).
      rewrite wk_pat_ge, length_cargs_pat.
      replace (List.length gs1 + (im_nn Mm + y)) with (List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) As) + (im_nn Mm + y))
        by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      rewrite sb_of_list_ge; unfold σP; rewrite iota_case_Ps, sb_of_list_app.
      replace (im_nn Mm + y) with (List.length Ns + y) by (rewrite iota_case_HNl; lia).
      rewrite sb_of_list_ge; cbn [sb_compose]; rewrite sentry_sub_id; reflexivity.
    Qed.

    Lemma iota_rec_arg_Mt : Γ ⊨ Mt : ptyp_ty_at p D Us σt t.
    Proof.
      assert (Hk : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' As (List.length gs1) Hk) as [M HM0].
      unfold Mt; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HM0).
      set (As1 := List.firstn (List.length gs1) As).
      assert (LAs1 : List.length As1 = List.length gs1) by (unfold As1; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      assert (HAeq : As = As1 ++ M :: List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) As)
        by (unfold As1; rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ HM0), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
      apply (HAs (List.length gs1)); [ exact HM0 |].
      rewrite Heq at 1; unfold cargs_ctx; rewrite cargs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux].
      rewrite HAeq.
      rewrite (tele_insts_app (cargs_ctx_aux p D (im_nn Mm) (true :: cargs_pat gs1) gs2
                                 ++ ce_ass ak_relevant (ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mm) (cargs_pat gs1) t) :: nil)
                 (cargs_ctx_aux p D (im_nn Mm) nil gs1)); [| apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | rewrite length_cargs_ctx_aux; exact LAs1 ].
      rewrite List.nth_error_app2 by (rewrite length_tele_insts by apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass; rewrite length_cargs_ctx_aux; lia).
      rewrite length_tele_insts by apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass; rewrite length_cargs_ctx_aux, LAs1.
      replace (List.length gs1 - Nat.min (List.length gs1) (List.length gs1)) with 0 by lia.
      change (M :: List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) As) with ((M :: nil) ++ List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) As).
      rewrite tele_insts_app; [| repeat econstructor | reflexivity ].
      cbn; unfold tele_insts at 1; cbn [List.rev List.app tele_insts_aux]; f_equal.
      rewrite ptyp_ty_eq_at, ptyp_ty_at_sub by (try exact Hc; apply length_ind_uvars).
      rewrite (ptyp_ty_at_sb_eq _ _ _ _ _ σt); [ f_equal |].
      - unfold ind_uvars; rewrite length_cargs_pat.
        unfold σP; rewrite <- sb_of_list_app, iota_case_Ps, <- List.app_assoc.
        replace (List.length gs1 + im_nn Mm) with (List.length (Ns ++ As1)) by (rewrite List.length_app, iota_case_HNl; lia).
        rewrite <- iota_case_HUl; apply vars_from_sb_of_list_app.
      - unfold σt; rewrite <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1 σP As); fold As1.
        apply cargs_sub_pat; exact LAs1.
    Qed.

The frame of the argument.
    Lemma iota_frame : sem_frame p D Γ Us Mm gs1 t nil σt Id Mt.
    Proof.
      constructor; cbn [List.app List.length].
      - exact HΓ.
      - exact (gsub_sigt gs1 _ Heq).
      - intros x; unfold sb_id, sb_of_wk; rewrite (wk_shiftn_zero x); reflexivity.
      - exact iota_rec_arg_uc.
      - rewrite iota_case_Us_id; exact iota_rec_arg_Mt.
      - assert (Hk : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' As (List.length gs1) Hk) as [M HM0].
        unfold Mt; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HM0).
        exact (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) HAss _ (List.nth_error_In _ _ HM0)).
      - intros y; rewrite iota_case_Us_id.
        assert (Lg1 : List.length gs1 <= List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        replace (y + List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_nparams Mm)) with ((y + im_nn Mm) + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))
          by (rewrite List.length_app, cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele, length_im_nparams; lia).
        unfold σt; rewrite cargs_sub_ge by exact Lg1.
        unfold σP; rewrite iota_case_Ps, sb_of_list_app.
        replace (y + im_nn Mm) with (List.length Ns + y) by (rewrite iota_case_HNl; lia).
        apply sb_of_list_ge.
    Qed.
  End RecArg.

The Instance of the Branch's Context

  Lemma gsub_args : gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As)) (con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs).
  Proof.
    pose proof (gsub_ns VP p D HP HPD Γ HΓ Us m Mm HMm (HMall _ _ HMm) Ns iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs iota_case_HNss) as HgN.
    pose proof (HBc _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon) as HB; unfold elim_bctx in HB.
    assert (HC : ⊨ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs)
      by (unfold con_inst_ctx; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HB; exact (rel_ctx_wf_app_r _ _ HB)).
    rewrite sb_of_list_app; unfold con_inst_ctx in HC |- *.
    apply gsub_of_list; [ exact HgN | apply all_assumptions_sub, cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact HC
                        | rewrite length_tele_sub, length_cargs_ctx; exact HAl | | exact HAss ].
    intros k N T HN HT; rewrite tele_insts_tele_sub in HT.
    rewrite (tele_insts_sb_eq _ _ σP) in HT; [ exact (HAs _ _ _ HN HT) |].
    rewrite <- iota_case_HNl; etransitivity; [ apply sb_qn_of_list |].
    etransitivity; [ apply sb_of_list_cong; intros x; cbn; apply sentry_sub_id |].
    unfold σP; rewrite iota_case_Ps, <- sb_of_list_app; reflexivity.
  Qed.

The branch's context's sorts (BranchSorts), at Us.
  #[local] Abbreviation BS f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks i HΓ iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss HBks HnmA HMall HAv HnaA
                                   HBc HarA HBv m Mm c gs HMm Hcon).
  #[local] Abbreviation recursive_results_prefix_valid := (BS recursive_results_prefix_valid).
  #[local] Abbreviation recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument := (BS recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument).
  #[local] Abbreviation instance_entry_kind := (instance_entry_kind gs).
  #[local] Abbreviation instance_entry_sort := (BS instance_entry_sort).

The recursive results along the leaf paths ls1 of a recursive argument t after gs1, over those before: an instance of their context.
  Lemma gsub_iota_leaves : forall gs1 t rest, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: rest -> forall L0, List.length L0 = cargs_nrec D gs1 ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L0))
        (ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs) ->
      forall ls1 ls2, shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) t = ls1 ++ ls2 ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L0 ++
                List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) (List.nth (List.length gs1) As (a_var 0))) ls1))
        (leaves_ctx ak_relevant (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (cargs_nrec D gs1) ls1
         ++ ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs).
  Proof.
    intros gs1 t rest Heq L0 HL Hδ ls1.
    assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
    destruct (nth_error_lt_some As _ Hlt) as [a Ha].
    rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Ha).
    destruct (length_rec_ps D HD m Mm HMm c gs gs1 t rest Hcon Heq) as (Mj & HMj & _).
    induction ls1 as [| l ls1 IH1] using List.rev_ind; intros ls2 Els.
    - cbn [List.map leaves_ctx List.app]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact Hδ.
    - specialize (IH1 (l :: ls2) ltac:(rewrite Els, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity)).
The entry of the path is a type.
      pose proof (recursive_results_prefix_valid (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) rest ltac:(rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq)) as HCT.
      rewrite recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument, Els, leaves_ctx_app, <- !List.app_assoc in HCT.
      apply rel_ctx_wf_app_r in HCT.
      rewrite leaves_ctx_app in HCT; cbn [leaves_ctx List.app] in HCT.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_ass_inv HCT) as [jT HTj].
The instance so far, extended by the path's result.
      rewrite List.map_app, leaves_ctx_app; cbn [leaves_ctx List.app List.map].
      set (L1 := L0 ++ List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a) ls1) in *.
      assert (LL1 : List.length L1 = cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1) by (unfold L1; rewrite List.length_app, List.length_map, HL; reflexivity).
      replace (Ns ++ As ++ L0 ++ List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a) ls1
                 ++ leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a l :: nil)
        with ((Ns ++ As ++ L1) ++ leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a l :: nil)
        by (unfold L1; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      replace (Ns ++ As ++ L0 ++ List.map (leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a) ls1) with (Ns ++ As ++ L1) in IH1
        by (unfold L1; reflexivity).
      rewrite (sb_of_list_app (Ns ++ As ++ L1) (_ :: nil) Id).
      change (sb_of_list (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L1)) (?N :: nil)) with (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L1) ,, N).
      eapply gsub_ass; [ exact IH1 | exact (proj1 HTj) | exact (proj2 HTj) | |].
      2:{
The path's result is scoped by Γ.
          assert (Lg1 : List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) As) = List.length gs1) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
          pose proof (member_closed_recs _ _ (decl_closed_members _ Hc _ _ HMm) _ _ _ _ _ (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ Hcon) Heq) as Ht.
          rewrite cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele in Ht.
          pose proof (shape_leaves_scoped (rview_leaves D) (ind_nu D) t (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))
                        (rview_leaves_scoped D Hc) ltac:(unfold im_np in Ht; replace (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + ind_nu D)
                                                           with (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + (im_nn Mm + ind_nu D)) by lia; exact Ht))
            as HLs.
          rewrite Els in HLs.
          apply (leaf_ih_scoped ak_relevant p D l Us Bks _ a (List.length Γ) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + ind_nu D) Hc
