                   iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUss HnmA HBss).
          - intros x Hx; rewrite <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1 σP As).
            apply (cargs_sub_bound gs1 σP _ (List.length Ps) _); [| exact (Forall_firstn' _ _ _ HAss) | exact Lg1 |].
            + intros y Hy; apply (sb_of_list_bound Ps Id 0 (List.length Γ)); [ intros; lia | exact HPss | lia ].
            + rewrite HPl; unfold im_np; lia.
          - exact (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) HLs l ltac:(apply List.in_or_app; left; apply List.in_or_app; right; left; reflexivity)).
          - exact (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) HAss _ (List.nth_error_In _ _ Ha)). }
      set (δ := sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L1)).
      rewrite leaf_ihty_sub.
      assert (Hθδ : sb_eq (ihs_sub (im_nn Mm) Us (List.length gs) (cargs_pat gs1) (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1) ⨟ δ)
                      (cargs_sub σP gs1 As)).
      { unfold δ, σP; rewrite <- LL1.
        exact (ihs_sub_iota D Mm Ps As L1 gs1 gs HPl HAl ltac:(rewrite Heq, List.length_app; lia)). }
      assert (Hbδ : sb_eq (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1 + List.length gs + im_nn Mm)) ⨟ δ) Id).
      { intros z; unfold δ; cbn [sb_compose sb_of_wk sentry_sub wk_shiftn].
        replace (z + (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1 + List.length gs + im_nn Mm)) with (List.length (Ns ++ As ++ L1) + z)
          by (rewrite !List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl, LL1; lia).
        rewrite sb_of_list_ge; reflexivity. }
      assert (Hidx : (a_var (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1 + List.length gs - 1 - List.length (cargs_pat gs1)))[δ] = a).
      { change (exp_sub (a_var ?y) ?s) with (sentry_exp (s y)); unfold δ.
        rewrite (sb_of_list_nth _ _ _ a) by (rewrite !List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl, LL1, Heq, List.length_app, length_cargs_pat; cbn; lia).
        rewrite !List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl, LL1, length_cargs_pat.
        replace (im_nn Mm + (List.length gs + (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1)) - 1
                   - (cargs_nrec D gs1 + List.length ls1 + List.length gs - 1 - List.length gs1))
          with (im_nn Mm + List.length gs1) by (rewrite Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        cbn [sentry_exp]; rewrite List.app_nth2 by (rewrite iota_case_HNl; lia); rewrite iota_case_HNl.
        replace (im_nn Mm + List.length gs1 - im_nn Mm) with (List.length gs1) by lia.
        rewrite List.app_nth1 by exact Hlt; apply List.nth_error_nth; exact Ha. }
      rewrite Hidx, (leaf_ihty_sb_eq ak_relevant l _ _ Id _ (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a Hbδ Hθδ).
The path's result, at the argument's frame.
      assert (Hinl : In l (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + 0) (ptyp_skip 0 t)))
        by (rewrite Nat.add_0_r; cbn [ptyp_skip]; rewrite Els; apply List.in_or_app; left; apply List.in_or_app; right; left; reflexivity).
      pose proof (leaf_ih_valid VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks i HΓ iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss HBks HnmA HMall HAv HnaA HBc
                    HarA HBv
                    (S (ptyp_mem t)) m Mm c gs gs1 t rest HMm Hcon Heq Mj HMj (fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_diag_r _)
                    _ _ _ _ (iota_frame gs1 t rest Heq) 0 l (Nat.le_0_l _) Hinl) as H.
      cbn [List.firstn doms_ctx List.map List.rev tele_sub List.app sb_shift_iter sb_qn apps_vars_iter] in H.
      rewrite iota_case_Us_id, blocks_sub_id, (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Ha) in H; exact (proj1 H).
  Qed.

  Lemma gsub_iota_ihs : forall rest gs1 L0, gs = gs1 ++ rest -> List.length L0 = cargs_nrec D gs1 ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L0))
        (ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 gs1 ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs) ->
      gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ L0 ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As)
                                          (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) rest (List.skipn (List.length gs1) As)))
        (ihs_ctx_aux ak_relevant (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm) (blocks_motives Bks) Us (List.length gs) nil 0 (gs1 ++ rest) ++ con_inst_ctx Γ p D Mm Us gs).
  Proof.
    induction rest as [| [rB B0 | t] rest IH]; intros gs1 L0 Heq HL Hδ.
    - cbn [elim_ihs]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Hδ.
    - assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some As _ Hlt) as [a Ha].
      rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Ha); cbn [elim_ihs].
      assert (Hcs : cargs_sub σP (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil) As = (cargs_sub σP gs1 As ,, a)).
      { rewrite <- cargs_sub_firstn, <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1), List.length_app, Nat.add_1_r, (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ Ha).
        apply cargs_sub_snoc_arg; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia. }
      replace (S (List.length gs1)) with (List.length (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil)) by (rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      replace (S (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))) with (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil)))
        by (rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      rewrite <- Hcs.
      replace (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: rest) with ((gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil) ++ rest) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      apply IH; [ rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity | rewrite cargs_nrec_app_iota; cbn; lia |].
      rewrite ihs_ctx_aux_app, List.app_nil_r; cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app]; exact Hδ.
    - assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some As _ Hlt) as [a Ha].
      rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Ha); cbn [elim_ihs].
      assert (Hcs : cargs_sub σP (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) As = cargs_sub σP gs1 As).
      { rewrite <- cargs_sub_firstn, <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1), List.length_app, Nat.add_1_r, (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ Ha).
        apply cargs_sub_snoc_rec; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia. }
      pose proof (gsub_iota_leaves gs1 t rest Heq L0 HL Hδ _ nil (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r _))) as Hall.
      rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Ha) in Hall.
      set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) t) in *.
      set (F := leaf_ih ak_relevant p Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) a) in *.
      replace (Ns ++ As ++ L0 ++ List.map F ls ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))
                 rest (List.skipn (S (List.length gs1)) As))
        with (Ns ++ As ++ (L0 ++ List.map F ls) ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks (cargs_sub σP (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) As)
                (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil))) rest
                (List.skipn (List.length (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil)) As))
        by (rewrite Hcs, cargs_nonrec_app, !List.length_app; cbn [cargs_nonrec List.length];
            rewrite !Nat.add_0_r, Nat.add_1_r, <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      replace (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: rest) with ((gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) ++ rest) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      apply IH; [ rewrite Heq, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity
                | rewrite List.length_app, List.length_map, HL, cargs_nrec_app_iota; cbn [cargs_nrec];
                  unfold ls; rewrite (length_shape_leaves _ _ _ 0); lia |].
      rewrite recursive_results_snoc_recursive_argument, <- List.app_assoc; exact Hall.
  Qed.

  Lemma gsub_iota : gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As))
      (elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ).
  Proof.
    pose proof gsub_args as Hδ.
    rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r As) in Hδ at 1.
    pose proof (gsub_iota_ihs gs nil nil eq_refl eq_refl ltac:(cbn [ihs_ctx_aux List.app]; exact Hδ)) as H.
    cbn [List.app List.skipn List.length cargs_sub cargs_nonrec] in H; rewrite Nat.add_0_r in H.
    unfold elim_bctx; unfold con_inst_ctx in H; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact H.
  Qed.

The constructor applied, the scrutinee.
  Lemma iota_Mc_valid : Γ ⊨ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As)
      : ind_mty p D m Us Ns.
  Proof.
    apply (con_apps_ref_valid VP p D HP HPD Γ m Mm c gs Us Ns As HΓ HMm HrvM Hcon iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs HAl).
    - intros * HN HT; apply (HAs _ _ _ HN); unfold σP; rewrite iota_case_Ps; exact HT.
    - rewrite List.app_assoc, <- iota_case_Ps; apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact HPss | exact HAss ].
  Qed.

It is scoped by Γ.
  Lemma iota_Mc_scoped : exp_scoped (List.length Γ) (apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As)).
  Proof.
    apply exp_scoped_apps; split; [ cbn; exact I |].
    apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact (im_pre_scoped D m Mm Us _ Hc HMm iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUss) |].
    apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact iota_case_HNss | exact HAss ].
  Qed.

The member the constructor's value is of, as the group reads it.
  Lemma ref_target : exists Dq Mk, ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) = Some Dq /\
      ind_member Dq (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) = Some Mk /\ im_unu D Mm = ind_nu Dq /\ im_nn Mk = im_nn Mm.
  Proof.
    unfold im_ref, im_unu; destruct (im_head Mm) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; cbn [fst snd].
    - exists D, Mm; repeat split; [ exact Hl | exact HMm ].
    - destruct (view_target_decl VP p D HP HPD m Mm HMm qc kc Is vm Hh) as (Dq & Mk' & pm & Hq & HMk' & _ & HIl).
      destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ Hvg) m Mm qc kc Is vm HMm Hh) as (Dq0 & Mc & Hq0 & HMc & Hnn & _).
      rewrite Hq in Hq0; injection Hq0 as <-; rewrite HMk' in HMc; injection HMc as <-.
      exists Dq, Mk'; repeat split; [ exact Hq | exact HMk' | exact HIl | exact Hnn ].
    - exfalso; pose proof HrvM as H; unfold im_is_rview in H; rewrite Hh in H; discriminate.
  Qed.

The Values at an Environment

At an environment C of Γ: the recursive results of the eliminator's own evaluation are related, by rec_results_rel, to the values of the recursive results elim_ihs in the branch's instance.
  Section IotaSem.
    #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
    Variable (RΓ RU : relation env).
    Hypotheses (HRΓ : EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ) (HRU : EF ind_uparams D ≈ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RU).
    Variable (C : env) (u0 ns avs : list domain).
    Hypotheses (HCC : RΓ C C) (HCt : ctx_retag Γ C = C) (HUC : ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ u0)
      (HNC : ⟦ Ns ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ ns) (HAC : eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_kinds gs) As C avs).
    Let nr := canon_nparams_rel D u0.
    Let ar := canon_args_rel D u0.
    Let dr := canon_doms_rel D u0.
    Let G := grp_rel p D u0 nr ar dr.
    Let mctx_tele j := match ind_member D j with Some Mj => List.rev (elim_mctx p D j Mj Us) | None => nil end.
    Let Rel := fun j ns m ns' m' =>
      per_head (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_prop) (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_prop)
        (env_tele C (mctx_tele j) (ns ++ m :: nil)) (env_tele C (mctx_tele j) (ns' ++ m' :: nil)).
    #[local] Abbreviation u0_len' := (u0_len D Us iota_case_HUl C u0 HUC).
    #[local] Abbreviation u0_env' := (u0_env VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss C u0 HCC HUC).
    #[local] Abbreviation u0_tele_args' := (u0_tele_args VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss C u0 HCC HUC).
    #[local] Abbreviation Hcp := (valid_group_canon p D Hvg u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len').
    #[local] Abbreviation HnP := (ind_canon_props_np_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HnI := (ind_canon_props_np_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HaP := (ind_canon_props_arg_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HaI := (ind_canon_props_arg_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HdP := (ind_canon_props_dom_per _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation HdI := (ind_canon_props_dom_iff _ _ Hcp).
    #[local] Abbreviation Had := (valid_group_adm p D Hvg u0 u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' u0_tele_args').
    #[local] Abbreviation Hass := (valid_group_ass _ _ Hvg).
    #[local] Abbreviation isym := (proj1 (ind_rel_sym_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (admissible_index_at D u0 nr))).
    #[local] Abbreviation itrans := (proj1 (ind_rel_trans_all p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (admissible_index_at D u0 nr))).
The lemmas of Elim.v: of the frames, of the base at C, and of the motives at C on both sides.
    #[local] Abbreviation trefl_l := (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI).
    #[local] Abbreviation SF f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss HMall).
    #[local] Abbreviation EB f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss C u0 HCC HUC).
    #[local] Abbreviation EP f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss C u0 HCC HUC C HCC
                                     Bks i HBks' HMall HAv).

    Lemma iota_sem_Ln : List.length ns = im_nn Mm.
    Proof. rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ HNC); exact iota_case_HNl. Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_La : List.length avs = List.length gs.
    Proof. rewrite (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_length _ _ _ _ HAC); exact HAl. Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_Mc : exists cs, List.length cs = im_unu D Mm /\
        ⟦ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As) ⟧ C
          ↘ d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs).
    Proof.
      destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_mty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm HRΓ iota_Mc_valid _ _ HCC) as (mv & _ & Emv & _ & _).
      assert (LNA : List.length (Ns ++ As) = (im_nn Mm + List.length gs)%nat) by (rewrite List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl; reflexivity).
      destruct (con_ref_apps_value VP p D HP HPD m Mm c gs C Us (Ns ++ As) (ns ++ avs) mv HMm HrvM Hcon iota_case_HUl
                  (con_ref_vals_join D m Mm gs Ns As C ns avs Hdt HMm iota_case_HNl HNC HAC) LNA Emv) as (cs & Lcs & ->).
      exists cs; split; assumption.
    Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_HgN : gsub Γ (sb_of_list Id Ns) (tele_sub (im_nparams Mm) (sb_of_list Id Us) ++ Γ).
    Proof. exact (gsub_ns VP p D HP HPD Γ HΓ Us m Mm HMm (HMall _ _ HMm) Ns iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs iota_case_HNss). Qed.

The scrutinee's relation at C.
    Lemma iota_sem_scrut : forall x y, per_head (ind_mty p D m Us Ns) (ind_mty p D m Us Ns) C C x y -> G m u0 u0 ns ns x y.
    Proof.
      intros x y Hxy.
      destruct (presup_rel_exp_under_ctx_mty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm iota_Mc_valid) as [iT HIT].
      destruct (rel_type_inversion_simple_at HRΓ HIT _ _ HCC) as (t1 & t2 & Et1 & Et2 & [R HR]).
      destruct (EB scrut_rel m Mm HMm (HMall _ _ HMm) Ns iota_case_HNl
                  iota_sem_HgN C HCC ns ns HNC HNC t1 t2 _ R Et1 Et2 HR) as [_ ERM].
      apply ERM, (per_head_iff Et1 Et2 HR); exact Hxy.
    Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_self : forall cs, List.length cs = im_unu D Mm ->
        ⟦ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As) ⟧ C
          ↘ d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs) ->
        G m u0 u0 ns ns (d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs))
          (d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs)) /\
        tele_rel (ar m ns c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs avs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs avs) /\
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr m u0 u0 ns ns (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) gs avs avs.
    Proof.
      intros cs Lcs Emc.
      destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_mty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm HRΓ iota_Mc_valid _ _ HCC) as (m1 & m2 & Em1 & Em2 & Hm12).
      assert (m1 = d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs)) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
      assert (m2 = d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs)) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
      pose proof (iota_sem_scrut _ _ Hm12) as Hm.
      split; [ exact Hm |].
      assert (Lb : List.length (cs ++ ns) = (im_unu D Mm + im_nn Mm)%nat) by (rewrite List.length_app, Lcs, iota_sem_Ln; reflexivity).
      rewrite List.app_assoc in Hm.
      destruct (ind_rel_con_inv p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm HMm HrvM Lb)
        as (gs0 & bs' & vs' & Ez & _ & _ & Hcon0 & Lbs' & _ & _ & Har & Hia).
      rewrite Hcon in Hcon0; injection Hcon0 as <-.
      injection Ez as Ez.
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Ez ltac:(congruence)) as [<- <-].
      rewrite (skipn_app_exact cs ns _ Lcs) in Har, Hia.
      split; assumption.
    Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_args : tele_rel (ar m ns c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs avs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs avs) /\
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr m u0 u0 ns ns (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) gs avs avs.
    Proof. destruct iota_sem_Mc as (cs & Lcs & Emc); exact (proj2 (iota_sem_self cs Lcs Emc)). Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_Hns : tele_rel (nr m) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm)) ns ns.
    Proof.
      destruct iota_sem_Mc as (cs & Lcs & Emc).
      exact (ind_rel_ns p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm (proj1 (iota_sem_self cs Lcs Emc))).
    Qed.

    Lemma iota_sem_HPC : ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ u0 ++ ns.
    Proof. rewrite iota_case_Ps; apply eval_exps_app; [ exact HUC | exact HNC ]. Qed.

The walk along the leaf paths (LeafVals), at C.
    #[local] Abbreviation LV f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ Us Bks i HΓ iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss HBks HnmA HMall HAv HnaA
                                     HBc HarA HBv RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C u0 HCC HUC (eq_ind_r (fun X => env_agree_upto (List.length Γ) C X)
                                                                                 (reflexivity C) HCt)).
    #[local] Abbreviation iota_arg_link := (iota_arg_link p D Γ C u0).

A recursive argument of the constructor: the scrutinee, moved along the weakening, is an element of the member, its argument related to the scrutinee's.
    Lemma iota_arg_link_start : forall gs1 t gs2, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
        forall a, List.nth_error avs (List.length gs1) = Some a ->
        iota_arg_link m (ns ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs))
          (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t a (List.nth (List.length gs1) As (a_var 0)) nil.
    Proof.
      intros gs1 t gs2 Heq a Ha Δ RΔ zs HRΔ Hw HE.
      change (List.length (@nil (domain * entry_type)) + List.length zs) with (List.length zs) in Hw.
      change (env_extend_typed C (nil ++ zs)) with (env_extend_typed C zs) in HE |- *.
      set (σL := sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (List.length zs))).
      assert (Hev : ⟦ σL : Γ ⟧s env_extend_typed C zs ↘ C).
      { pose proof (@eval_sub_of_wk gc_deps gc_stack Γ (wk_shiftn (List.length zs)) (env_extend_typed C zs) (wk_mono_shiftn _)) as H.
        rewrite eval_wk_shiftn_extend_typed, HCt in H; exact H. }
      destruct (presup_rel_exp_under_ctx_mty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm iota_Mc_valid) as [iT HIT].
      destruct (rel_type_inversion_simple_at HRΓ HIT _ _ HCC) as (t1 & _ & Et1 & _ & _).
      destruct (exp_inst_link _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ iota_Mc_valid HRΔ Hw HE Hev
                  (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (ex_intro _ t1 (conj Et1 (ind_mty_relevant _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Et1))) evaluated_kind_relevant))
        as (mw & mC & Emw & EmC & Hm).
      destruct iota_sem_Mc as (cs & Lcs & EMc).
      assert (mC = d_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c (cs ++ ns ++ avs)) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
      apply iota_sem_scrut, isym in Hm.
      rewrite apps_exp_sub in Emw; cbn [exp_sub] in Emw.
      fold σL in Emw; rewrite !List.map_app, (im_pre_sub D m Mm Us σL Hc HMm iota_case_HUl) in Emw.
      assert (LNA : List.length (List.map (fun N => N[σL]) Ns ++ List.map (fun N => N[σL]) As) = (im_nn Mm + List.length gs)%nat)
        by (rewrite List.length_app, !List.length_map, iota_case_HNl, HAl; reflexivity).
      destruct (con_ref_apps_sorted VP p D HP HPD m Mm c gs (env_extend_typed C zs) (List.map (fun U => U[σL]) Us) _ mw HMm HrvM Hcon
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact iota_case_HUl) LNA Emw) as (zs' & Ezs).
      destruct (con_ref_vals_split D m Mm gs _ _ _ _ Hdt HMm ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact iota_case_HNl) Ezs)
        as (ns1 & as1 & -> & Ens1 & Eas1).
      assert (Ln1 : List.length ns1 = im_nn Mm) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ens1), List.length_map; exact iota_case_HNl).
      destruct (con_ref_apps_value VP p D HP HPD m Mm c gs (env_extend_typed C zs) (List.map (fun U => U[σL]) Us) _ _ mw HMm HrvM Hcon
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact iota_case_HUl) Ezs LNA Emw)
        as (cs' & Lcs' & ->).
      rewrite (List.app_assoc cs ns avs) in Hm.
      destruct (ind_rel_con_inv p D u0 nr ar dr Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm HMm HrvM
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_app, Lcs, iota_sem_Ln; reflexivity))
        as (gs0 & bs' & vs' & Ez & _ & _ & Hcon0 & Lbs' & _ & _ & _ & Hia).
      rewrite Hcon in Hcon0; injection Hcon0 as <-.
      injection Ez as Ez; rewrite List.app_assoc in Ez.
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Ez ltac:(rewrite Lbs', List.length_app, Lcs', Ln1; reflexivity)) as [<- <-].
      rewrite (skipn_app_exact cs ns _ Lcs), (skipn_app_exact cs' ns1 _ Lcs') in Hia.
      destruct (con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia gs1 t gs2 Heq) as (x & x' & Hx & Hx' & Hshw).
      rewrite Ha in Hx; injection Hx as <-.
      assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' As _ Hlt) as [M0 HM0].
      rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HM0).
      destruct (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_nth _ _ _ _ Eas1 (List.length gs1) (M0[σL])
                  ltac:(rewrite List.nth_error_map, HM0; reflexivity)) as (v0 & Hv0 & Ev0 & _).
      rewrite Hx' in Hv0; injection Hv0 as <-.
      specialize (Ev0 ltac:(rewrite Heq, (cargs_kinds_rec gs1 t gs2); constructor)).
      exists (ns1 ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) as1)), x'; split; [| exact Hshw ].
      unfold σL in Ev0; rewrite exp_sub_of_wk in Ev0; exact Ev0.
    Qed.

The Components of a Recursive Argument

The value at C of the components of the shape of a recursive argument: over C, the parameters' values and the non-recursive arguments' before it, of their sorts, at types that read back.
    Lemma iota_sigma_value : forall gs1 t gs2, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
        exists wts, ⟦ cargs_sub σP gs1 As : cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ ⟧s C ↘ env_extend_typed C wts /\
          List.map fst wts = u0 ++ ns ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs) /\
          List.Forall (fun vt => entry_readable (de_term (fst vt) (snd vt))) wts.
    Proof.
      intros gs1 t gs2 Heq.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      set (K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)).
      set (K0 := cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm).
      set (n := List.length K0).
      assert (Lg1 : List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) As) = List.length gs1)
        by (rewrite List.length_firstn, HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
      set (nt := nonrec_arg_terms gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) As)).
      set (Ms := Ps ++ nt).
      assert (Lnt : List.length nt = K) by (unfold nt, K; apply length_nonrec_arg_terms; exact Lg1).
      assert (Ln : n = K + List.length Ps)
        by (unfold n, K0; rewrite List.length_app, cargs_nonrec_ctx_rev_tele, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele, length_im_params, HPl;
            fold K; lia).
      assert (LMs : List.length Ms = n) by (unfold Ms; rewrite List.length_app, Lnt; lia).
      assert (Eσ : cargs_sub σP gs1 As = sb_of_list Id Ms)
        by (rewrite <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1 σP As), cargs_sub_of_list; unfold σP, Ms; rewrite sb_of_list_app; reflexivity).
The semantic substitution's value.
      destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_simple (gsub_valid (gsub_sigt gs1 _ Heq))) as (R1 & HR1 & RT & HRT & Hs).
      assert (E1 : RΓ <~> R1) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; [ exact HRΓ | exact HR1 ]).
      destruct (Hs _ _ (proj1 (E1 _ _) HCC)) as (e1 & e1' & Ee1 & _ & He1).
      assert (HPT : PER RT) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRT).
      assert (He11 : RT e1 e1) by (etransitivity; [ exact He1 | symmetry; exact He1 ]).
      pose proof (SF frame_nonrec_ctx_all_assumptions m Mm c gs gs1 t gs2 HMm Hcon Heq) as HK0a; fold K0 in HK0a.
      assert (HRT' : EF K0 ++ Γ ≈ K0 ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RT) by (unfold K0; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact HRT).
      set (rf := frame_rf gs gs1).
The entries' propositionality is decided by their relevance.
      assert (Hdec : forall x, x < n -> evaluated_kind (rf x) ->
                       ~ entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr; rewrite List.app_assoc.
        refine (evaluated_entry_not_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT' e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        unfold rf in Hr; exact (proj1 (SF frame_entry_sort m Mm c gs gs1 t gs2 HMm Hcon Heq x Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1) Hr). }
      assert (Hpr : forall x, x < n -> rf x = ak_propositional ->
                      entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr; rewrite List.app_assoc.
        refine (prop_entry_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT' e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        unfold rf in Hr; exact (proj2 (SF frame_entry_sort m Mm c gs gs1 t gs2 HMm Hcon Heq x Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1) Hr). }
      assert (ETg : cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mm ++ Γ = List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ)
        by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; unfold K0; rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite Eσ, ETg in Ee1; rewrite ETg in Hdec, Hpr.
      destruct (eval_sb_of_list_sorted_split Ms (List.rev K0) Id Γ C e1 rf ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia) Ee1
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hdec) ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hpr))
        as (ms & Lms & Hms & Hagr).
The values: the parameters', then the non-recursive arguments'.
      set (nv1 := nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs)).
      assert (Hnvf : eval_field_vals gc_deps gc_stack (cargs_nonrec_kinds gs1) nt C nv1).
      { unfold nt, nv1; apply (eval_field_vals_nonrec gs1 (cargs_kinds (ca_rec t :: gs2))); [| exact Lg1 ].
        unfold cargs_kinds; rewrite <- List.map_app, <- Heq; fold (cargs_kinds gs).
        exact (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_firstn _ _ _ _ HAC (List.length gs1)). }
      assert (Hmsv : ms = u0 ++ ns ++ nv1).
      { pose proof (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_length _ _ _ _ Hnvf) as Lnv1.
        pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ iota_sem_HPC) as LPC.
        apply (List.nth_ext _ _ d_prop d_prop); [ rewrite !List.length_app in *; lia |].
        intros j Hj.
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' Ms j ltac:(lia)) as [M HM].
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' ms j ltac:(lia)) as [v Hv].
        destruct (Hms j M v HM Hv) as [HmR HmP].
        rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hv).
        destruct (Nat.lt_ge_cases j (List.length Ps)) as [Hj1 | Hj1].
        -
A parameter: relevant.
          assert (Erf : rf (List.length Ms - 1 - j) = ak_relevant)
            by (unfold rf, frame_rf; fold K; replace (List.length Ms - 1 - j <? K) with false by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_ge; lia);
                reflexivity).
          unfold Ms in HM; rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HM by exact Hj1.
          destruct (eval_exps_nth _ _ _ _ _ iota_sem_HPC HM) as (y & Hy & Ey).
          rewrite List.app_assoc, List.app_nth1 by (rewrite LPC; exact Hj1).
          rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hy); exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ (HmR ltac:(rewrite Erf; constructor)) Ey).
        -
A non-recursive argument: of its sort.
          set (k := j - List.length Ps).
          unfold Ms in HM; rewrite List.nth_error_app2 in HM by exact Hj1; fold k in HM.
          destruct (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_nth _ _ _ _ Hnvf k M HM) as (y & Hy & Ey1 & Ey2).
          rewrite List.app_assoc, List.app_nth2 by (rewrite LPC; exact Hj1).
          replace (j - List.length (u0 ++ ns)) with k by (unfold k; rewrite <- LPC, List.length_app; reflexivity).
          rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hy).
          assert (Hk : k < K) by (unfold k; rewrite Lms, LMs in Hj; lia).
          destruct (nth_error_lt_some' (cargs_nonrec gs1) k Hk) as [A0 HA0].
          destruct (nonrec_kind_nth _ _ _ HA0) as [r Hr].
          assert (Erf : rf (List.length Ms - 1 - j) = r).
          { unfold rf, frame_rf; fold K.
            replace (List.length Ms - 1 - j <? K) with true by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; lia).
            replace (K - 1 - (List.length Ms - 1 - j)) with k by (unfold k; lia).
            rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_kinds_app, List.nth_error_app1 by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
            rewrite Hr; reflexivity. }
          rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ ak_relevant Hr) in Ey1, Ey2.
          destruct (evaluated_kind_or_propositional r) as [Hre | ->].
          + exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ (HmR ltac:(rewrite Erf; exact Hre)) (Ey1 Hre)).
          + rewrite (HmP Erf), (Ey2 eq_refl); reflexivity. }
      
The value past the entries: C.
      assert (Lpj : List.length (List.rev K0) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
      pose proof (eval_sb_of_list_tail _ _ _ _ _ _ Lpj Ee1) as Htail.
      pose proof (functional_eval_sub _ _ _ _ _ Htail (@eval_sub_id gc_deps gc_stack Γ C)) as Hag; rewrite HCt in Hag.
      set (wts := tagged_entries Γ (List.rev K0) C ms).
      assert (HagT : env_agree_upto (List.length (List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ)) e1 (env_extend_typed C wts)).
      { unfold wts; rewrite <- env_extend_tagged_typed, List.length_app, !List.length_rev.
        intros x Hx; rewrite Hagr.
        exact (env_extend_tagged_agree (List.rev K0) Γ _ _ ms ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia) Hag x
                 ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia)). }
      exists wts; split; [ rewrite ETg, Eσ; exact (eval_sub_resp_agree _ _ _ _ _ Ee1 HagT) | split ].
      - unfold wts; rewrite tagged_entries_fst by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia); exact Hmsv.
      - rewrite <- ETg in HagT; pose proof (per_ctx_env_resp_agree HRT _ _ _ _ HagT HagT He11) as HEσ.
        assert (HKr : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ)
          by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; unfold K0; rewrite <- List.app_assoc;
              exact (SF frame_target_valid m Mm c gs gs1 t gs2 HMm Hcon Heq)).
        assert (HRTr : EF List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ ≈ List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RT)
          by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact HRT').
        assert (Lv : List.length wts = List.length (List.rev K0))
          by (unfold wts; rewrite tagged_entries_length by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia); rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
        exact (proj1 (per_tele_args_of_env_extend_readable _ _ _ _ HRΓ HKr (List.Forall_rev HK0a) HRTr _ _ _ _ Lv Lv HEσ)).
    Qed.

The Recursive Results of the Arguments

The recursive results of the arguments after gs1: the eliminator's own and the values of elim_ihs, related.
    Lemma iota_sem_ihs : forall rest gs1, gs = gs1 ++ rest ->
        exists ihe ihc, ⟦ihs List.skipn (List.length gs1) avs of rest under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ ihe /\
          ⟦ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) rest
              (List.skipn (List.length gs1) As) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ ihc /\
          rec_results_rel D dr Rel m u0 u0 (ns ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs))
            (ns ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs)) (List.rev (im_nparams Mm) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) rest
            (List.skipn (List.length gs1) avs) (List.skipn (List.length gs1) avs) ihc ihe.
    Proof.
      pose proof (leaves_coherent_of_order _ (rview_struct_order _ _ _ (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ Hdt))) as Hco.
      induction rest as [| g rest IH]; intros gs1 Heq.
      - assert (E : List.skipn (List.length gs1) avs = nil)
          by (apply List.skipn_all2; rewrite iota_sem_La, Heq, List.app_nil_r; lia).
        rewrite E; exists nil, nil; split; [ constructor | split; [ cbn; constructor | constructor ] ].
      - assert (Hlt : List.length gs1 < List.length avs) by (rewrite iota_sem_La, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some avs _ Hlt) as [v Hv].
        assert (HltA : List.length gs1 < List.length As) by (rewrite HAl, Heq, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some As _ HltA) as [M0 HM0].
        assert (Lf : List.length (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs) = List.length gs1) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (Heq' : gs = (gs1 ++ g :: nil) ++ rest) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq).
        destruct (IH _ Heq') as (ihe & ihc & Ee & Ec & Hr).
        rewrite List.length_app in Ee, Ec, Hr; cbn [List.length] in Ee, Ec, Hr; rewrite Nat.add_1_r in Ee, Ec, Hr.
        rewrite (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ Hv), nonrec_arg_vals_app in Hr by exact Lf.
        rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app in Hr.
        rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ Hv), (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ HM0).
        rewrite cargs_nonrec_app, List.length_app in Ec.
        destruct g as [rB B0 | t].
        + assert (Hcs : cargs_sub σP (gs1 ++ ca_arg rB B0 :: nil) As = (cargs_sub σP gs1 As ,, M0)).
          { rewrite <- cargs_sub_firstn, <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1), List.length_app, Nat.add_1_r, (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ HM0).
            apply cargs_sub_snoc_arg; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia. }
          rewrite Hcs in Ec; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals cargs_nonrec List.length List.map] in Hr, Ec.
          rewrite !List.app_assoc in Hr.
          replace (im_nn Mm + (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) + 1)) with (S (im_nn Mm + List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))) in Ec by lia.
          exists ihe, ihc; split; [ constructor; exact Ee | split; [ cbn [elim_ihs]; exact Ec |] ].
          apply rec_results_arg; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Hr |- *; exact Hr.
        + assert (Hcs : cargs_sub σP (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) As = cargs_sub σP gs1 As).
          { rewrite <- cargs_sub_firstn, <- (cargs_sub_firstn gs1), List.length_app, Nat.add_1_r, (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ HM0).
            apply cargs_sub_snoc_rec; rewrite List.length_firstn; lia. }
          rewrite Hcs in Ec; cbn [nonrec_arg_vals cargs_nonrec List.length List.map] in Hr, Ec.
          rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hr.
          rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Ec.
          destruct (length_rec_ps D HD m Mm HMm c gs gs1 t rest Hcon Heq) as (Mj & HMj & _).
The argument at its frame, at C.
          set (nv1 := nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) avs)) in *.
          destruct iota_sem_args as (Hnva & Hia).
          destruct (con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia gs1 t rest Heq) as (x & x' & Hx & Hx' & Hsh).
          rewrite Hv in Hx, Hx'; injection Hx as <-; injection Hx' as <-.
          assert (Hnv : tele_prefix_rel (ar m ns c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) nv1 nv1).
          { unfold nv1; rewrite <- (List.firstn_skipn (List.length gs1) avs) in Hnva.
            exact (nonrec_prefix_gen _ gs gs1 (ca_rec t :: rest) _ _ _ _ Heq Lf Lf Hnva). }
          assert (Lnv1 : List.length nv1 = List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) by (apply length_nonrec_arg_vals; exact Lf).
          assert (Hvals : sem_frame_vals D Γ RΓ RU C u0 Mm gs1 nil (cargs_sub σP gs1 As) (List.nth (List.length gs1) As (a_var 0))
                            RΓ (env_extend_typed C nil) C nil u0 ns nv1 v).
          { constructor; cbn [env_extend_typed List.fold_left List.length].
            - exact HCC.
            - reflexivity.
            - reflexivity.
            - exact HCC.
            -
The components' value: over C, the parameters' and the non-recursive arguments' values.
              destruct (iota_sigma_value gs1 t rest Heq) as (wts & Ew & Hwv & Hrw).
              exists C, wts; split; [ exact Ew | split; [ exact Hwv | exact Hrw ] ].
            - rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HM0).
              destruct (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_nth _ _ _ _ HAC (List.length gs1) M0 HM0)
                as (v0 & Hv0 & Ev0 & _).
              rewrite Hv in Hv0; injection Hv0 as ->; apply Ev0.
              rewrite Heq, (cargs_kinds_rec gs1 t rest); constructor.
            - exact u0_env'.
            - exact u0_len'.
            - exact iota_sem_Ln.
            - exact Lnv1. }
          destruct (LV leaf_ihs_vals (S (ptyp_mem t)) m Mm c gs gs1 t rest HMm Hcon Heq Mj HMj (fun _ => Nat.lt_succ_diag_r _)
                      _ _ _ _ (iota_frame gs1 t rest Heq) RΓ HRΓ ns nv1 nil u0 ns nv1 v Hvals iota_sem_Hns Hnv 0 nil nil v v (ns ++ nv1)
                      (Nat.le_0_l _) eq_refl (List.Forall_nil _) (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)
                      ltac:(cbn [ptyp_skip List.map List.firstn]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact Hsh)
                      ltac:(cbn [ptyp_skip apps_vars_iter List.app List.map List.firstn]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r;
                            exact (iota_arg_link_start gs1 t rest Heq v Hv)))
            as [rs' rs Ers' Ers Hrs].
          cbn [ptyp_skip sb_shift_iter sb_qn apps_vars_iter List.app env_extend_typed List.fold_left List.map List.firstn]
            in Ers, Ers', Hrs.
          rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hrs; rewrite Nat.add_0_r, iota_case_Us_id, blocks_sub_id, (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HM0) in Ers'.
          exists (rs ++ ihe), (rs' ++ ihc); split; [ constructor; [ exact Ers | exact Ee ] | split ].
          * cbn [elim_ihs]; apply eval_exps_app; [ exact Ers' | exact Ec ].
          * apply rec_results_rec; [| | exact Hrs | exact Hr ].
            -- rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ers'), List.length_map; apply length_shape_leaves.
            -- exact (proj1 (proj2 eval_ih_length_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ers D Hl Hco).
    Qed.

The sorts of the branch's context's entries (BranchSorts).
    #[local] Abbreviation branch_context_entry_kind := (branch_context_entry_kind D gs).
    #[local] Abbreviation branch_context_entry_sort := (BS branch_context_entry_sort RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C u0 HCC HUC HrvM).

The Branch's Instance at C

The value of the instance of the branch's context: over C, the non-uniform parameters', the arguments' of their sorts and the recursive results', at types that read back.
    Lemma iota_tau_value : forall ihc,
        ⟦ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C ↘ ihc ->
        exists wts, ⟦ sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As)
                      : elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ ⟧s C ↘ env_extend_typed C wts /\
          List.map fst wts = ns ++ avs ++ ihc /\
          List.Forall (fun vt => entry_readable (de_term (fst vt) (snd vt))) wts.
    Proof.
      intros ihc Ec.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      set (Ihs := elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As) in *.
      set (K0 := elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us).
      set (Ms := Ns ++ As ++ Ihs).
      assert (Lih : List.length Ihs = cargs_nrec D gs) by (apply length_elim_ihs; exact HAl).
      assert (LK0 : List.length K0 = cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm) by apply length_elim_bctx.
      assert (LMs : List.length Ms = List.length K0) by (unfold Ms; rewrite !List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl, Lih, LK0; lia).
The semantic substitution's value.
      destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_simple (gsub_valid gsub_iota)) as (R1 & HR1 & RT & HRT & Hs).
      assert (E1 : RΓ <~> R1) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; [ exact HRΓ | exact HR1 ]).
      destruct (Hs _ _ (proj1 (E1 _ _) HCC)) as (e1 & e1' & Ee1 & _ & He1).
      assert (HPT : PER RT) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRT).
      assert (He11 : RT e1 e1) by (etransitivity; [ exact He1 | symmetry; exact He1 ]).
      pose proof (elim_bctx_ass ak_relevant p D m Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us Hc HMm) as HK0a; fold K0 in HK0a.
The entries' propositionality is decided by their sorts.
      assert (Hdec : forall x, x < List.length K0 -> evaluated_kind (branch_context_entry_kind x) ->
                       ~ entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (K0 ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr.
        refine (evaluated_entry_not_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        destruct (branch_context_entry_sort Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0) as [i0 HT0].
        assert (Hk : branch_context_entry_kind x = ak_relevant \/ branch_context_entry_kind x = ak_level) by (destruct Hr; auto).
        rewrite HΔ1 in HT0; exists i0; destruct Hk as [Hk | Hk]; rewrite Hk in HT0; [ left | right ]; exact HT0. }
      assert (Hpr : forall x, x < List.length K0 -> branch_context_entry_kind x = ak_propositional -> entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (K0 ++ Γ) e1 x).
      { intros x Hx Hr.
        refine (prop_entry_propositional K0 Γ RT x HK0a Hx _ HRT e1 e1 He11).
        intros Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0 HΔ1.
        destruct (branch_context_entry_sort Δ1 κ0 T0 Δ2 E0) as [i0 HT0].
        rewrite HΔ1, Hr in HT0; exact HT0. }
      assert (ETg : K0 ++ Γ = List.rev (List.rev K0) ++ Γ) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive; reflexivity).
      fold K0 Ihs Ms in Ee1, HRT.
      rewrite ETg in Ee1, Hdec, Hpr.
      destruct (eval_sb_of_list_sorted_split Ms (List.rev K0) Id Γ C e1 branch_context_entry_kind ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; lia) Ee1
                  ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hdec) ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hpr))
        as (ms & Lms & Hms & Hagr).
The values: the parameters', the arguments', the results'.
      assert (Hmsv : ms = ns ++ avs ++ ihc).

        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' ms j ltac:(lia)) as [v Hv].

A parameter: relevant.

An argument: of its sort.
            set (k := j - im_nn Mm).
            unfold Ms in HM; rewrite List.nth_error_app2, iota_case_HNl in HM by (rewrite iota_case_HNl; exact Hj1).
            fold k in HM; rewrite List.nth_error_app1 in HM by (rewrite HAl; unfold k; lia).
            destruct (Mctt.Core.Completeness.Records.Model.eval_field_vals_nth _ _ _ _ HAC k M HM) as (y & Hy & Ey1 & Ey2).
            rewrite List.app_nth2 by (rewrite LNC, iota_case_HNl; exact Hj1).

            assert (Erf : branch_context_entry_kind (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j)
                          = match g with ca_arg r _ => r | ca_rec _ => ak_relevant end).
            { unfold branch_context_entry_kind, instance_entry_kind.
              replace (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j <? cargs_nrec D gs) with false
                by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_ge; lia).
              replace (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j - cargs_nrec D gs <? List.length gs) with true
                by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; lia).
              replace (List.length gs - 1 - (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j - cargs_nrec D gs)) with k
                by (unfold k; lia).
              rewrite Hg; destruct g; reflexivity. }
            assert (Ecr : List.nth k (cargs_kinds gs) ak_relevant
                          = match g with ca_arg r _ => r | ca_rec _ => ak_relevant end)
              by (unfold cargs_kinds; erewrite List.nth_error_nth; [ reflexivity | rewrite List.nth_error_map, Hg; reflexivity ]).
            rewrite Ecr in Ey1, Ey2; rewrite Erf in HmR, HmP.
            destruct g as [[| |] A0 | t0].
            * exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ (HmR ltac:(constructor)) (Ey1 ltac:(constructor))).
            * rewrite (HmP eq_refl), (Ey2 eq_refl); reflexivity.
            * exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ (HmR ltac:(constructor)) (Ey1 ltac:(constructor))).
            * exact (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ (HmR ltac:(constructor)) (Ey1 ltac:(constructor))).

A recursive result: relevant.
            set (k := j - (im_nn Mm + List.length gs)).
            assert (Erf : branch_context_entry_kind (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j) = ak_relevant).
            { unfold branch_context_entry_kind.
              replace (cargs_nrec D gs + List.length gs + im_nn Mm - 1 - j <? cargs_nrec D gs) with true
                by (symmetry; apply Nat.ltb_lt; lia).

            unfold Ms in HM; rewrite List.app_assoc, List.nth_error_app2 in HM

The value past the entries: C.
      assert (Lpj : List.length (List.rev K0) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).

The Two Sides at C

The eliminator at the constructor and the branch at its instance have related values at C: the eliminator's own branch environment and the instance's value are related at the branch's context, their recursive results by iota_sem_ihs.
    Lemma iota_sem_core : forall n B, brs_lookup (eb_brs bm) c = Some (n, B) ->
        exists l r, ⟦ a_elim ak_relevant p Us m Bks (apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As)) ⟧ C ↘ l /\
          ⟦ B[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As)] ⟧ C ↘ r /\
          Dom l ≈ r ∈ per_head ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c)
                                                           (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As) :: nil)])
                               ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c)
                                                           (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As) :: nil)]) C C.
    Proof.
      intros n B Hlk.
      assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
      set (Mc := apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As)).
      destruct iota_sem_Mc as (cs & Lcs & EMc).
      destruct (iota_sem_self cs Lcs EMc) as (Hself & Har & Hia).
      destruct (iota_sem_ihs gs nil eq_refl) as (ihe & ihc & Ee & Ec & Hir).
      cbn [List.length List.skipn List.firstn nonrec_arg_vals cargs_sub cargs_nonrec cargs_nonrec_tele List.map] in Ee, Ec, Hir.
      rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hir; rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Ec.
      assert (Hsk : List.skipn (im_unu D Mm) (cs ++ ns) = ns) by exact (skipn_app_exact cs ns _ Lcs).
      rewrite (List.app_assoc cs ns avs) in Hself, EMc.
The branch's context.
      pose proof (HBc _ _ _ _ HMm Hcon) as HBm.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HBm) as [RB HRB].

The instance's value.

The eliminator's own branch environment, its entries reading back.

            exact (HBv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hb Hc0 (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hl1))).

The two environments, related at the branch's context.

The relations, at the motive's instance.
      assert (HBn : rel_type_not_level_sort (elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mm gs (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ)

      pose proof (per_head_inst_type _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HTb HRΓ (gsub_valid gsub_iota) HCC Hτ Hτ) as ER.
      assert (Lih : List.length (elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As) = cargs_nrec D gs) by (apply length_elim_ihs; exact HAl).
      rewrite (elim_branch_type_iota p D m Mm c gs (eb_motive bm) Us Ns As _ Hc HMm iota_case_HUl iota_case_HNl HAl Lih) in ER.
      assert (EC1 : per_head (elim_branch_type p D m Mm c gs (eb_motive bm) Us) (elim_branch_type p D m Mm c gs (eb_motive bm) Us)
                      (env_extend_typed C wts1) (env_extend_typed C vts2)

                          (env_extend_typed C wts1) (env_extend_typed C wts1)).
      { apply (per_head_of_type_resp HRB HTb).
        apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact Hec |]. apply rel_chain_cons; [ symmetry; exact Hec |]. apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact HE11. }
      pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (gsub_tau VP p D HP HPD Γ HΓ Us iota_case_HUl m Mm HMm (HMall _ _ HMm) Ns Mc
                                            iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs iota_Mc_valid
                                            (proj2 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) (conj iota_case_HNss (List.Forall_cons _ iota_Mc_scoped (List.Forall_nil _)))))
                    (HAv _ _ _ HMm Hbm)) as HTm; cbn [exp_sub] in HTm.
      pose proof (rel_type_of_typ HTm) as HT.
      assert (H21 : per_head ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ Mc :: nil)]) ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ Mc :: nil)]) C C r2 r1)
        by (apply ER, EC1; exact Hr21).
      assert (Hr2' : per_head ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ Mc :: nil)]) ((eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ Mc :: nil)]) C C r r2)
        by (apply ER; exact Hrn).
      pose proof (per_head_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT HCC _ _ _ Hr2' H21) as Hrr1.
      exact (per_head_sym _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT HCC _ _ Hrr1).
    Qed.

  End IotaSem.

The Rule

  Lemma rel_exp_under_ctx_elim_iota_at : forall n B, brs_lookup (eb_brs bm) c = Some (n, B) ->
      Γ ⊨ a_elim ak_relevant p Us m Bks (apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As))
        ≈ B[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ As ++ elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As)]
        : (eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c)
                                                (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As) :: nil)].
  Proof.
    intros n B Hlk.
    set (Mc := apps (a_con (fst (im_ref p m Mm)) (snd (im_ref p m Mm)) c) (im_pre Mm Us ++ Ns ++ As)).
    pose proof iota_Mc_valid as HMc; fold Mc in HMc.
The left side, an eliminator.
    assert (HUU : forall j U U' T, List.nth_error Us j = Some U -> List.nth_error Us j = Some U' ->
               List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) j = Some T -> Γ ⊨ U ≈ U' : T)
      by (intros * HU HU' HT; rewrite HU in HU'; injection HU' as <-; exact (iota_case_HUs _ _ _ HU HT)).
    assert (HAA : forall k Mk b b', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b' ->
               elim_mctx p D k Mk Us ++ Γ ⊨ eb_motive b ≈ eb_motive b' : Typeω@i)
      by (intros * HMk Hb Hb'; rewrite Hb in Hb'; injection Hb' as <-; exact (HAv _ _ _ HMk Hb)).
    assert (HBB : forall k Mk b b' c0 gs0 n0 B0 B0', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.nth_error Bks k = Some b ->
               List.nth_error Bks k = Some b' -> ind_con Mk c0 = Some gs0 ->
               brs_lookup (eb_brs b) c0 = Some (n0, B0) -> brs_lookup (eb_brs b') c0 = Some (n0, B0') ->
               elim_bctx ak_relevant p D Mk gs0 (blocks_motives Bks) Us ++ Γ ⊨ B0 ≈ B0' : elim_branch_type p D k Mk c0 gs0 (eb_motive b) Us)
      by (intros * HMk Hb Hb' Hc0 Hl1 Hl2; rewrite Hb in Hb'; injection Hb' as <-; rewrite Hl1 in Hl2; injection Hl2 as <-;
          exact (HBv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb Hc0 (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hl1))).
    pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_elim_at VP p D HP HPD Γ m Mm bm Bks Bks Us Us Ns Mc Mc i HΓ HMm Hbm HBks HBks
                  iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUs iota_case_HUss iota_case_HUl iota_case_HUss HUU iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs iota_case_HNss
                  HMc iota_Mc_scoped HnmA HnmA HMall HAA HnaA
                  (fun _ _ _ H1 H2 => ltac:(rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <-; reflexivity)) HBc HarA HBB) as HL.
The right side, the branch at its instance.
    pose proof gsub_iota as Hgi.
    pose proof (HBv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hbm Hcon (brs_lookup_in _ _ _ _ Hlk)) as HBv'.
    assert (Lih : List.length (elim_ihs ak_relevant p D Us Bks σP (im_nn Mm) gs As) = cargs_nrec D gs) by (apply length_elim_ihs; exact HAl).
    pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub Hgi HBv') as HR.
    rewrite (elim_branch_type_iota p D m Mm c gs (eb_motive bm) Us Ns As _ Hc HMm iota_case_HUl iota_case_HNl HAl Lih) in HR; fold Mc in HR.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HΓ) as [RΓ HRΓ].
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env Usem) as [RU HRU].
    assert (HPΓ : PER RΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΓ).
The motive's instance is of a universe.
    pose proof (rel_exp_under_ctx_gsub (gsub_tau VP p D HP HPD Γ HΓ Us iota_case_HUl m Mm HMm (HMall _ _ HMm) Ns Mc
                                          iota_case_HNl iota_case_HNs HMc
                                          (proj2 (List.Forall_app _ _ _) (conj iota_case_HNss (List.Forall_cons _ iota_Mc_scoped (List.Forall_nil _)))))
                  (HAv _ _ _ HMm Hbm)) as HTm.
    destruct (presup_rel_exp_under_ctx HL (rel_exp_of_typ_not_level_sort HTm)) as [iT HT].
    apply (rel_exp_under_ctx_of_simple HRΓ HL HR).
    intros ρ ρ' Hρρ'.
    assert (Hρ'ρ' : RΓ ρ' ρ') by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Hρρ' | exact Hρρ' ]).
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_evaluated HRΓ HL _ _ Hρρ'
                (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (rel_exp_of_typ_relevant_at HRΓ HTm _ _ Hρρ') evaluated_kind_relevant))
      as (l & l' & El & El' & Hll').
The two sides at ρ' retagged at Γ: its values are the eliminator's environment, and a weakening into Γ evaluates to it.
    set (C := ctx_retag Γ ρ').
    assert (HCρ : RΓ C ρ') by exact (per_ctx_env_retag_left HRΓ _ _ Hρ'ρ').
    assert (HCC : RΓ C C) by (etransitivity; [ exact HCρ | symmetry; exact HCρ ]).

      as (u0 & u0' & Hu0 & Hu0' & _).
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_mty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm HRΓ HMc _ _ HCC) as (mv & _ & Emv & _ & _).
    assert (LNA : List.length (Ns ++ As) = (im_nn Mm + List.length gs)%nat)
      by (rewrite List.length_app, iota_case_HNl, HAl; reflexivity).
    destruct (con_ref_apps_sorted VP p D HP HPD m Mm c gs C Us (Ns ++ As) mv HMm HrvM Hcon iota_case_HUl LNA Emv) as (vrest & Evrest).
    destruct (con_ref_vals_split D m Mm gs Ns As C vrest Hdt HMm iota_case_HNl Evrest) as (ns & avs & -> & HNC & HAC).
    destruct (iota_sem_core RΓ RU HRΓ HRU C u0 ns avs HCC HCt Hu0 HNC HAC n B Hlk) as (l0 & r0 & El0 & Er0 & Hlr0).
    fold Mc in El0, Hlr0.
Each side at C against ρ'.
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_evaluated HRΓ HL _ _ HCρ
                (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (rel_exp_of_typ_relevant_at HRΓ HTm _ _ HCρ) evaluated_kind_relevant))
      as (l1 & l2 & El1 & El2 & Hl12).

    assert (l2 = l') as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    destruct (rel_exp_under_ctx_simple_at_evaluated HRΓ HR _ _ HCρ
                (rel_typ_evaluated_of_kind (rel_exp_of_typ_relevant_at HRΓ HTm _ _ HCρ) evaluated_kind_relevant))
      as (r1 & r' & Er1 & Er' & Hr1').

    right; exists l, r'; split; [ exact El | split; [ exact Er' |] ].
    set (T := (eb_motive bm)[sb_of_list Id (Ns ++ Mc :: nil)]) in *.
All the relations at ρ and ρ'.
    assert (EC1 : per_head T T C ρ' <~> per_head T T ρ ρ').
    { apply (per_head_of_type_resp HRΓ HT).
      apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact HCρ |]. apply rel_chain_cons; [ symmetry; exact Hρρ' |]. apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact Hρρ'. }
    assert (EC2 : per_head T T C C <~> per_head T T ρ ρ').
    { apply (per_head_of_type_resp HRΓ HT).
      apply rel_chain_cons; [ exact HCC |]. apply rel_chain_cons; [ etransitivity; [ exact HCρ | symmetry; exact Hρρ' ] |].
      apply rel_chain_of_pair; exact Hρρ'. }
    apply EC1 in Hl12; apply EC1 in Hr1'; apply EC2 in Hlr0.
    pose proof (per_head_sym _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT Hρρ' _ _ Hl12) as Hl'0.
    pose proof (per_head_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT Hρρ' _ _ _ Hll' Hl'0) as H1.
    pose proof (per_head_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT Hρρ' _ _ _ H1 Hlr0) as H2.
    exact (per_head_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΓ HT Hρρ' _ _ _ H2 Hr1').
